A recovered conversation also keeps one identity in the sidebar after its content is verified or its parent is deleted, and a rebuild or shutdown of the session list no longer waits on a job that was already replaced. Nothing in your session files is rewritten.
body.zh: 更新之后，或会话列表在全新缓存上重建时，冲突恢复产生的副本可能被当成单独的对话列出来（有报告里 13 个对话变成 25 行）。现在后台检查完成后，已被其父会话覆盖的副本会重新隐藏。恢复出来的对话在内容校验或父会话被删除之后，也在侧栏里保持同一个身份；会话列表重建或退出时，不再等待一个已被替换的任务。不会改写你的任何会话文件。

title.en: The recovery status clears after an import retry succeeds
title.zh: 导入重试成功后，恢复状态不再残留

body.en: When an older session failed to import because of a workspace conflict and a later retry (or replay of an already completed import) succeeded, the earlier recovery status could stay behind. It is now cleared once the import is verified for exactly that source, version and target; failures of other sources stay pending. This does not bring back sessions that were never imported.
body.zh: 旧会话因工作区冲突导入失败，之后重试（或重放一次已完成的导入）成功时，之前的恢复状态可能一直留着。现在一旦确认这次导入对应的正是那个来源、版本和目标，就会清除它；其他来源的失败仍保持待处理。这并不会找回从未导入过的会话。

title.en: Goal runs show their accumulated working time
title.zh: 目标模式会显示累计的工作时长

body.en: A goal that had worked through several automatic rounds still showed 0s of work time. The time spent actively working on the goal is now added up (pauses and time the app was closed do not count), kept with the session, and shown again after a restart. It is not given to the model.
body.zh: 一个已经自动进行了好几轮的目标，工作时长仍显示 0s。现在会累计在目标上实际工作的时间（暂停期间和应用关闭的时间不算），随会话保存，重启后仍会显示。这个数值不会提供给模型。

title.en: Commands starting with ! find the programs on your login shell's PATH
title.zh: 以 ! 开头的命令能找到登录 shell 的 PATH 里的程序

body.en: When the desktop app is launched from the Dock or a similar launcher, it does not inherit the PATH your login shell sets up in .zshrc or .bashrc, so a command typed with ! could not find tools installed there. The login shell's PATH is now read before such a command runs and merged with the inherited one, keeping the existing entries and dropping duplicates; if the login shell cannot be queried, the inherited PATH is used as before.
body.zh: 从程序坞等启动器打开桌面应用时，它不会继承你在 .zshrc 或 .bashrc 里设置的登录 shell 的 PATH，所以用 ! 输入的命令找不到装在那里的工具。现在运行这类命令之前会读取登录 shell 的 PATH，并与继承来的 PATH 合并，保留原有项并去重；如果无法查询登录 shell，就像以前一样使用继承来的 PATH。

title.en: Remote sessions show an unread dot, and switching sessions no longer shows false connection warnings
title.zh: 远程会话也会显示未读圆点，切换会话不再出现误报的连接警告

body.en: A remote session now behaves like a local one: when a response finishes in the background an unread dot appears, and it clears once you read it. Session lists refresh when a background session finishes or ends, whether or not the one in front is running. Ordinary session switches no longer leave a false connection warning, a late reply from the session you switched away from can no longer overwrite the one in front, and real connection failures stay visible and clear on their own once the connection recovers. Update the remote Serve as well as the desktop app for the full behaviour; with an older Serve the dots fall back to timestamps.
body.zh: 远程会话现在和本地会话表现一致：后台的回复完成时会出现未读圆点，读过之后消失。后台会话完成或结束时会刷新会话列表，不论前台那个是否正在运行。普通的会话切换不再留下误报的连接警告，切走的会话迟到的回复也不会覆盖前台的状态，真实的连接失败仍然可见，连接恢复后会自行消除。要获得完整效果，需要同时更新远程的 Serve 和桌面应用；Serve 较旧时，圆点会退回按时间戳判断。

title.en: Go toolchain and network library updated to versions with published security fixes
title.zh: Go 工具链和网络库升级到已发布安全修复的版本

body.en: The Go toolchain moves to 1.26.9 and golang.org/x/net to 0.60.0 (with the golang.org/x modules it requires), which clear the standard-library and x/net vulnerabilities the vulnerability scan reported on this line. The scan reports none reachable from Reasonix afterwards.
body.zh: Go 工具链升级到 1.26.9，golang.org/x/net 升级到 0.60.0（连同它要求的 golang.org/x 各模块），修复了漏洞扫描在这条线上报出的标准库和 x/net 的漏洞；升级之后，扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。

title.en: A recovered group's sidebar id can change once
title.zh: 恢复组在侧栏里的标识可能变化一次

body.en: Repairing an older cached identity for a recovered conversation group whose records carry no topic id can change that group's id once. An id written explicitly in your session files, and the files themselves, are never changed.
body.zh: 修复旧缓存里没有主题标识的恢复对话组的身份时，该组的标识可能变化一次。你的会话文件里显式写下的标识以及文件本身都不会被改动。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.8

summary.en: Fixes for pasted images and tool-result images blocking every later message on models that never declared image support, sessions that could not be opened after an interrupted reply, QQ approval requests that never arrived, session delete and archive failing in projects shared with Studio, archiving a legacy recovery chain in one action, sub-agent tool calls showing up in the main conversation, and an intermittent Command Code error.
summary.zh: 修复未声明读图能力的模型被图片卡住后续所有消息、回复被中断后会话无法打开、QQ 审批请求收不到、与 Studio 共用的项目里删除和归档会话反复失败，旧版恢复链一次归档，子代理工具调用出现在主对话里，以及 Command Code 的一个偶发错误。

title.en: Deleting or archiving a session no longer fails over and over after the catalog starts rescanning
title.zh: 目录反复重扫时，删除或归档会话不再一直失败

body.en: In some projects (seen when the same project folder was also opened by Studio 2.x) the session catalog rescanned the folder every few seconds even though no session had changed, and every delete or archive then failed with "This session is already performing the same operation". Lock files, temporary files, sidecar files and subdirectory timestamps no longer trigger a rescan; only session transcripts, their metadata and event logs do. Rescans of one folder now back off from 1 s up to 60 s, a real delete or rename still skips the backoff, and the archive path waits up to 1.5 s for a busy lock instead of giving up at once. No session file is written, moved or deleted.
body.zh: 在部分项目里（同一个项目文件夹也被 Studio 2.x 打开过时出现），目录没有任何会话变化，却每隔几秒被重新扫描一次，随后任何删除或归档都会失败，提示「该会话正在执行相同操作」。现在锁文件、临时文件、附属文件和子目录的时间戳不再触发重扫，只有会话记录、元数据和事件日志的变化才会；同一目录的重扫会从 1 秒起逐步退避到 60 秒，真实的删除和改名不受退避影响；归档遇到忙碌的锁时最多等待 1.5 秒，不再立刻放弃。不会写入、移动或删除任何会话文件。

title.en: Archiving a legacy recovery row now archives the whole recovery chain in one action
title.zh: 归档旧版恢复行时，整条恢复链一次归档

body.en: Archiving one row of an old recovery lineage used to retire only one to four snapshots, so each click left a new copy behind and the same set had to be archived dozens of times. The whole chain is now found by walking the parent links, and archived in one action. The lock is released between snapshots, so other tabs keep working while a long chain is archived. If a snapshot cannot be archived the rest still are, the result reports how many remain, and running the action again finishes it. Source files are never deleted or rewritten, and archived copies stay restorable from Archived.
body.zh: 归档旧版恢复链里的某一行时，原来只会处理一到四个快照，每点一次都会留下新的副本，同一批要归档几十次。现在会顺着父节点找到整条恢复链，并一次归档。每个快照之间会释放锁，所以归档很长的链时，其他标签仍可正常使用。个别快照归档失败时其余照常归档，结果会报告还剩几个，再执行一次即可补完。源文件不会被删除或改写，已归档的副本仍可从「已归档」恢复。

title.en: Images are blocked only for models declared as text-only
title.zh: 只有声明为不读图的模型才会拦截图片

body.en: A model with no declared image capability (a custom gateway or a model missing from the catalog) was treated as unable to read images: attaching one failed with "no image understanding model is configured", and once a conversation held any image, even from a tool result such as view_image or a browser screenshot, every later message including plain text failed the same way. Only a model declared text-only (vision = false, a vision_models list that omits it, or the catalog) is now blocked; an undeclared model receives the image and the provider answers, and when a configured image model exists it is still used as before. Images from tool results and earlier messages that no model can read are replaced in the request by a short note, and the saved conversation is not changed. A new image attached on a model declared text-only is still refused. Models not declared as image-capable are now left to the provider: if the provider truly cannot read images it will still refuse, and you will need to switch to another model.
body.zh: 没有声明读图能力的模型（自建网关，或目录里没有的模型）以前会被当作不能读图：附加图片会报「没有配置图片理解模型」，而且对话里一旦出现图片（包括 view_image、浏览器截图等工具结果里的图片），之后的每条消息，连纯文字也一样失败。现在只有明确声明为不读图的模型（vision = false、vision_models 列表里没有它，或目录里如此标注）才会被拦截；未声明的模型会直接收到图片，由服务商回答；已配置图片模型时仍按原样使用它。工具结果和历史消息里没有任何模型能读的图片，会在请求里换成一句简短的说明，已保存的对话不会被改动。在声明为不读图的模型上新附加图片仍会被拒绝。未声明读图能力的模型现在交给服务商处理：如果服务商确实不能读图，仍会拒绝，此时需要换用其他模型。

title.en: Fixed a transcript record-id collision caused by interrupted replies
title.zh: 修复被中断的回复造成的会话记录标识冲突

body.en: Two interrupted replies saved without a message id derived the same internal record identity, so the transcript was rejected as a whole and the session could not be opened. Such records now get distinct identities. Genuinely duplicated message or tool records are still rejected, and no session file is rewritten. This fixes the collision found in #10456; other causes of that report are not covered.
body.zh: 两条被中断的回复在保存时没有消息标识，会推导出相同的内部记录标识，导致整份会话记录被拒绝、会话打不开。现在这类记录会得到各自不同的标识。真正重复的消息或工具记录仍会被拒绝，也不会改写任何会话文件。这只修复了 #10456 中发现的这一处冲突，该报告的其他成因不在此列。

title.en: QQ approval buttons use the correct message format, with a plain-text fallback
title.zh: QQ 审批按钮改用正确的消息格式，并增加纯文本回退

body.en: In QQ conversations the message with approval buttons was rejected by QQ (HTTP 500, code 50015001) while ordinary replies still went through, and it was never retried. The buttons are now sent in the format the QQ message API expects, and a rejected rich message is resent as plain text that keeps the approval instructions. Who may press a button and who may approve are unchanged.
body.zh: 在 QQ 对话里，带审批按钮的消息会被 QQ 拒绝（HTTP 500，错误码 50015001），而普通回复照常到达，且不会重试。现在按钮会按 QQ 消息接口要求的格式发送，被拒绝的富文本消息会改用保留审批说明的纯文本重发。谁能点按钮、谁能批准保持不变。

title.en: Sub-agent tool calls stay inside their sub-agent card
title.zh: 子代理的工具调用留在各自的子代理卡片里

body.en: Tool calls made by a background sub-agent (task or fleet) appeared as separate rows in the main conversation, without arguments or results, also after reopening a session. The parent id of each call was dropped when a session is read from its transcript records; it is now kept, so the calls nest under their sub-agent card again.
body.zh: 后台子代理（task 或 fleet）发出的工具调用会作为独立的行出现在主对话里，没有参数和结果，重新打开会话后也一样。原因是从会话记录读取时丢掉了每个调用的父级标识；现在保留了它，这些调用重新嵌套在各自的子代理卡片里。

title.en: Command Code requests retry once after an intermittent anonymous 400
title.zh: Command Code 的请求遇到偶发的匿名 400 时会重试一次

body.en: Command Code's Responses route sometimes answers an unchanged request body with an anonymous 400 that succeeds when sent again. For that host and that error shape the request is now resent once with the same body; named schema errors, other hosts and other statuses are not retried.
body.zh: Command Code 的 Responses 接口偶尔会对同一份请求体返回一个没有具体信息的 400，再发一次就成功。现在对这个服务商和这种错误形态，会用同一份请求体重发一次；带具体信息的参数错误、其他服务商和其他状态码都不会重试。

title.en: Archiving a very long recovery chain can take a while
title.zh: 归档很长的恢复链可能需要一段时间

body.en: Each snapshot of the chain is archived separately (about 2 MB each in the reported case), so a chain of dozens can take tens of seconds. Other work continues in the meantime; if the action reports that some snapshots remain, run it again.
body.zh: 恢复链里的每个快照都会单独归档（报告的案例里每个约 2 MB），几十个快照可能要花几十秒。期间其他操作可以继续；如果提示还有快照未完成，再执行一次即可。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.7

summary.en: Desktop fixes for session totals resetting, long-turn history paging, remote session switching, forked sessions and Goal editing, plus a partial fix for sessions missing after migration.
summary.zh: 桌面端修复：会话用量统计清零、长轮次历史分页、远端会话切换、分叉会话和编辑目标，并部分修复迁移后会话消失的问题。

title.en: Session totals no longer reset when you switch away and back
title.zh: 切换会话后再切回来，用量统计不再清零

body.en: Sessions in the current store kept no usage snapshot, so request count, tokens, cost and read-file records reset to zero after switching to another session and back. They are now saved per session and restored when it opens; a missing or damaged file falls back to empty and never blocks the switch.
body.zh: 当前存储格式的会话没有保存用量快照，切换到别的会话再切回来后，请求数、令牌数、费用和已读文件记录都会归零。现在这些数据按会话保存，打开会话时恢复；文件缺失或损坏时回退为空，不会影响切换。

title.en: Switching remote sessions while one is busy keeps your message and history
title.zh: 远端会话忙碌时切换，消息和历史不再丢失

body.en: A submission made while the remote session was between states could fail outright, busy submissions did not show in the queue at once, and returning to a visited session waited for the full history. Temporary transitions are now retried with the message and attachments kept, queued messages appear immediately, running sessions stay attached in the background, and a visited session paints its resident history first, then reconciles with the authoritative one.
body.zh: 远端会话处于过渡状态时提交的消息可能直接失败，忙碌时提交的消息不会立刻出现在队列里，回到访问过的会话还要等完整历史加载。现在临时过渡会在保留消息和附件的前提下重试，排队的消息立即显示，运行中的会话在后台保持连接，访问过的会话先显示已有历史，再与权威历史对账。

title.en: A long turn cut by a history page boundary folds, and the newest page loads at the bottom
title.zh: 被历史分页截断的长轮次可以折叠，滚到底部会自动加载最新一页

body.en: When a history page cut a turn, its tool cards stayed expanded with no fold button until the earlier page loaded. That group now folds like any settled turn. After loading older pages, reaching the bottom of the window now requests the next page once automatically, so a folded long turn no longer looks like the end of the conversation. The manual buttons stay.
body.zh: 历史分页把一轮对话截成两半时，后半部分的工具卡片会一直展开且没有折叠按钮，直到前一页加载完。现在它和其他已完成的轮次一样可以折叠。加载更早的页面后，滚到窗口底部会自动请求下一页一次，折叠起来的长轮次不再看起来像对话结尾。手动按钮仍然保留。

title.en: A second fork of one session no longer makes the workspace history unloadable
title.zh: 同一个会话第二次分叉后，工作区历史不再无法加载

body.en: A fork's source is its parent session directory, and a source can be registered only once. The second fork of the same parent hit a conflict and the workspace history failed to load. The registration is now skipped when that source is already mapped.
body.zh: 分叉的来源是它的父会话目录，而一个来源只能登记一次。同一个父会话的第二次分叉会撞上冲突，导致工作区历史无法加载。现在来源已登记时会跳过重复登记。

title.en: Editing a Goal opens an in-app form instead of failing
title.zh: 编辑目标改为应用内表单，不再点击后无反应

body.en: The composer's Edit goal action called a browser prompt that the desktop shell does not support, so clicking it did nothing. It now opens an inline form with the objective and the maximum rounds, with validation.
body.zh: 输入框里的「编辑目标」调用了桌面外壳不支持的浏览器输入框，点击后没有任何反应。现在改为内嵌表单，可以修改目标和最大轮数，并带校验。

title.en: Sessions from older tabs in an unregistered project no longer stop at a workspace conflict (partial fix)
title.zh: 未登记项目里旧标签页的会话不再卡在工作区冲突（部分修复）

body.en: Migrating a saved tab that points into a project directory no registered project owns used the tab's own scope, which could report a workspace conflict. The scope now comes from the session's recorded project root when it matches that directory; any other mismatch still reports the conflict. This is only a partial fix for #11641: entries already marked as conflicts are not cleared automatically, and the reporter's exact case is still under investigation.
body.zh: 迁移一个指向未登记项目目录的旧标签页时，会沿用标签页自己的范围，可能报「工作区冲突」。现在当会话记录的项目根目录与该目录一致时，范围取自会话记录；其他不一致仍会报告冲突。这只是 #11641 的部分修复：已被标记为冲突的条目不会自动清除，报告者的具体情况仍在调查。

title.en: Some migrated sessions may still be missing (#11641)
title.zh: 部分迁移后的会话可能仍然缺失（#11641）

body.en: Recovery entries already marked as workspace conflicts are not cleared by this release. If sessions are still missing after updating, please add details to #11641.
body.zh: 本版本不会清除已经被标记为工作区冲突的恢复条目。更新后如果会话仍然缺失，请到 #11641 补充信息。

title.en: A new message wins over an interrupted turn's recovery notice
title.zh: 新消息优先于被中断轮次的恢复提示

body.en: After a turn was force-stopped, the recovery notice did not say which instruction wins, so an unrelated new message could be read as a cue to finish the old task. The notice now states that your new message takes precedence and the old task should not be resumed if the two are unrelated.
body.zh: 强制停止一轮对话后，恢复提示没有说明以哪条指令为准，无关的新消息可能被当成继续旧任务的信号。现在提示明确写出：以你的新消息为准，两者无关时不要恢复旧任务。

title.en: A session whose history cannot load shows the reason
title.zh: 会话历史加载失败时显示具体原因

body.en: "Unable to load this session" replaced the real cause with a generic sentence. The Details panel now includes the reader's own failure, so the cause can be reported and diagnosed.
body.zh: 「无法加载此会话」原先用一句通用提示盖住了真实原因。现在「详情」里会附上读取失败的具体原因，便于反馈和排查。

title.en: A failed historical import says why and where to look
title.zh: 历史对话导入失败时说明原因和查看位置

body.en: A failed "Import and open" always showed one sentence. The banner and the historical list now name the class of failure (for example workspace conflict, history too large or damaged, unsupported version, source busy), keep the detail behind the details toggle, and offer a "Review recovery details" action that opens Settings > Storage. A failure to open after a successful import no longer reads as a failed import.
body.zh: 「导入并打开」失败时原先总是同一句话。现在提示条和历史列表会写出失败类别（例如工作区冲突、历史过大或损坏、版本不受支持、来源被占用），详情收在展开项里，并提供「查看恢复详情」入口，直接打开设置中的存储页。导入成功后打开失败，也不再被说成导入失败。

title.en: Manual sidebar order can be reset
title.zh: 可以重置侧边栏的手动排序

body.en: After a project was reordered by hand, its sidebar stayed in manual order even when you chose created or updated time. The project menu now has "Reset manual order", which turns manual order off and keeps your saved groups and positions.
body.zh: 项目手动调整排序后，即使选择按创建或更新时间排序，侧边栏仍保持手动顺序。项目菜单新增「重置手动排序」，关闭手动排序并保留已保存的分组和位置。

title.en: Closing the desktop releases the bot bridge and usage recorders
title.zh: 关闭桌面端时释放机器人桥接和用量记录线程

body.en: Each desktop start left a bot-bridge goroutine and per-folder usage-recording goroutines running for the lifetime of the process, which piled up over long sessions. They now shut down with the app.
body.zh: 桌面端每次启动都会留下机器人桥接线程和按目录的用量记录线程，运行期间一直不释放，长时间使用会越积越多。现在它们随应用一起关闭。

title.en: Windows shell commands no longer print encoding errors first
title.zh: Windows 上的 shell 命令不再先输出编码错误

body.en: The PowerShell prologue could throw before your command ran (no console attached, or ConstrainedLanguage mode), printing error lines ahead of every result. Each setting is now applied defensively. On Windows PowerShell 5.1, `>` and `Out-File` write UTF-8 instead of UTF-16, and text piped to native programs no longer starts with a byte-order mark. The Microsoft Store PowerShell 7 is detected when its alias actually starts.
body.zh: PowerShell 的前置脚本在没有控制台或处于 ConstrainedLanguage 模式时会在你的命令之前报错，每次结果前都带着错误行。现在每项设置都有保护。在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 上，`>` 和 `Out-File` 改为写入 UTF-8 而不是 UTF-16，通过管道传给原生程序的文本也不再以字节序标记开头；能真正启动的 Microsoft Store 版 PowerShell 7 也会被识别。

title.en: A too-long Windows command line is named instead of "filename too long"
title.zh: Windows 命令行过长时给出明确原因，不再报「文件名太长」

body.en: A shell command that embeds a large block of text exceeds the 32,767-character Windows command-line limit and used to fail with "The filename or extension is too long". The call is now refused before launch with the size, the limit, a note that nothing ran, and a pointer to `write_file`/`edit_file`.
body.zh: shell 命令内嵌大段文字时会超过 Windows 32,767 字符的命令行上限，过去只报「文件名或扩展名太长」。现在会在启动前拒绝，并说明实际大小和上限、告知没有执行任何内容，提示改用 `write_file` 或 `edit_file`。

title.en: Resuming a goal no longer fails on unused parameters
title.zh: 恢复目标时不再因多余参数失败

body.en: Resuming a Goal could be rejected when the model echoed its objective, a null round limit and an empty blocker. Lifecycle actions now accept fields that belong to other actions without applying them, and the result lists any unused value so it cannot be mistaken for an applied edit.
body.zh: 模型在恢复目标时回传了目标描述、空的轮数上限和空的阻塞原因，会被工具拒绝。现在目标的生命周期操作会接受属于其他操作的字段但不应用它们，结果里会列出未生效的值，避免被误当成已生效的修改。

title.en: Permission presets stay with their own remote session
title.zh: 权限预设跟随各自的远程会话

body.en: On an SSH remote workspace, changing the permission preset in one session could affect another, and the choice was lost when switching sessions or restarting the remote service. Each session now keeps its own preset, and a fork starts no broader than `workspace-write`.
body.zh: 在 SSH 远程工作区里，修改一个会话的权限预设可能影响另一个会话，切换会话或重启远程服务后选择还会丢失。现在每个会话各自保存预设，分叉出的会话权限不会比 `workspace-write` 更宽。

title.en: Bot conversations open from the Bots sidebar
title.zh: 机器人对话可以从机器人侧边栏打开

body.en: A bot conversation could fail to open while the embedded bot still held its session. The desktop and the embedded bot now share one session service, and the sidebar opens the stored transcript read-only.
body.zh: 内嵌机器人仍占用会话时，从桌面端机器人侧边栏打开该对话可能失败。现在桌面端和内嵌机器人共用同一个会话服务，侧边栏以只读方式打开已保存的记录。

title.en: New conversations stay reachable in a hand-ordered sidebar
title.zh: 手动排序的侧边栏里新对话不再找不到

body.en: Dragging one conversation turned on manual order and flipped the list so the oldest sat on top, while new conversations were appended to the tail, out of reach of the first page. The first drag now keeps the order you were looking at, and a new conversation goes to the top.
body.zh: 拖动一个对话会开启手动排序，并把列表整个颠倒成最旧的在最上面，新对话还被追加到末尾，翻不到第一页。现在第一次拖动会保持你当时看到的顺序，新对话放在最前面。

title.en: Trashing one version of a legacy conversation archives them all once
title.zh: 移入废纸篓时旧版对话的所有版本只归档一次

body.en: For legacy transcripts with unnamed forks or versions behind a concurrent save, one click archived one version at a time, and re-archiving earlier versions could write extra session copies. All versions of the conversation are now archived together, and versions already archived are not copied again. Nothing is deleted.
body.zh: 对于带有未命名分叉或并发保存后产生版本的旧版对话，每点一次只归档一个版本，重复归档已处理的版本还可能多写出会话副本。现在会一次归档该对话的所有版本，已归档的版本不再重复复制，也不会删除任何内容。

title.en: Archiving a legacy version keeps the open sibling attached
title.zh: 归档旧版本时不再动正在使用的同级版本

body.en: Archiving one version of a legacy conversation could create a second copy of a sibling version that is already open as an active session, and move that session's source link to the copy. Versions that already have a source mapping are now left alone.
body.zh: 归档旧版对话的某个版本时，可能给已作为活跃会话打开的同级版本再造一份副本，并把该会话的来源关联挪到副本上。现在已有来源关联的版本不会再被动到。

title.en: "Load full" works on a reasoning block that is still streaming
title.zh: 仍在输出的思考块可以点「加载全文」

body.en: Clicking the load-full button inside a streaming thinking block snapped back to the 8000-character preview at the next chunk. The block now follows the live text while streaming, and the canonical full text loads once it settles.
body.zh: 在仍在输出的思考块里点「加载全文」，下一段内容到达时会立刻退回 8000 字的预览。现在输出期间思考块会跟随实时文本，结束后再一次性加载完整内容。

title.en: Every ended turn can be folded by hand
title.zh: 每个已结束的轮次都能手动折叠

body.en: Turns that ended by being stopped, failing, or leaving an unfinished tool call were left expanded with no control to fold them. Any ended turn that has a process now shows the fold control, and your choice is remembered per turn. Such turns still start expanded so the interruption stays visible.
body.zh: 因停止、出错或留有未完成工具调用而结束的轮次会保持展开，且没有折叠入口。现在只要是带过程的已结束轮次都会显示折叠控件，并按轮次记住你的选择；这类轮次默认仍保持展开，使中断情况一目了然。

title.en: Upgrading no longer leaves permanent configuration warnings
title.zh: 升级后不再残留清不掉的配置告警

body.en: After upgrading from 1.38 to 1.39.5, project permission rules written by an older version, and the same Windows folder spelled two ways, kept showing configuration-problem banners even though conversations worked. Rules your existing grants already cover are now recognised, and project declarations that are not approved yet are kept for inspection instead of being reported as configuration failures. Project settings still cannot grant access or restore a revoked grant.
body.zh: 从 1.38 升级到 1.39.5 后，旧版本写入的项目权限规则，以及同一个 Windows 文件夹的不同写法，会一直弹出配置有问题的提示，尽管对话本身正常。现在已有授权覆盖的规则会被识别，尚未批准的项目声明会保留供查看，不再被当作配置失败。项目设置仍然不能授予权限，也不能恢复已撤销的授权。

title.en: A dead idle connection no longer fails the next turn
title.zh: 连接在空闲时已断开，不再让下一轮对话失败

body.en: After a pause, the next turn could fail with `unexpected EOF` because the request went out on a pooled connection that had already been dropped. Since 1.39.0 a request was sent exactly once, so this surfaced as an error. The request is now resent once on a fresh connection, only when it used a reused idle connection and no response byte arrived. Other failures, timeouts and cancellations are not resent.
body.zh: 停顿一段时间后，下一轮对话可能因 `unexpected EOF` 失败，原因是请求走了已被对端断开的复用空闲连接；自 1.39.0 起请求只发送一次，所以这个失败直接暴露给了用户。现在只有在请求使用了复用的空闲连接、且没有收到任何响应字节时，才会在新连接上重发一次；其他失败、超时和取消不会重发。

title.en: A resent request can, in a rare race, be billed twice
title.zh: 重发的请求在极少数竞态下可能被重复计费

body.en: The resend after a dead idle connection is capped at one. If the provider had already received the first request just before the connection dropped, that turn is billed twice; this is not expected to be common.
body.zh: 空闲连接已断开后的重发最多一次。如果连接断开前服务商恰好已收到第一次请求，这一轮会被计费两次，预计不常见。

summary.en: Fixes for upgrade warnings that would not go away, a dropped connection after a pause, Windows shell commands, and many desktop session and sidebar problems.
summary.zh: 修复升级后清不掉的配置告警、停顿后连接已断导致的请求失败、Windows 上的 shell 命令问题，以及多处桌面端会话与侧边栏问题。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.6

title.en: Permission rules for unknown tools are rejected when saved
title.zh: 保存权限规则时拒绝未知工具名

body.en: The desktop settings no longer save a rule such as deny = ["rm"] that names no registered tool and would never match. It suggests the Bash(...) form instead; MCP tool names are accepted while their server is disconnected.
body.zh: 桌面设置不再保存像 deny = ["rm"] 这样不对应任何已注册工具、永远不会生效的规则，并给出应写成的 Bash(...) 形式；MCP 服务暂时断开时，它的工具名仍可保存。

title.en: Provider failure details survive cleanup and restart
title.zh: 模型请求失败的诊断信息在收尾和重启后保留

body.en: A failed model request keeps its final status and failure class through cleanup, and reopening the session still shows it. Model input and retry behaviour are unchanged.
body.zh: 模型请求失败后，最终状态与失败分类在收尾时不再丢失，重新打开会话后仍能看到。发给模型的内容和重试策略不变。

title.en: The title-bar logo follows the theme
title.zh: 标题栏图标跟随主题配色

body.en: The title-bar mark now uses the theme's accent colour, so it stays visible on dark themes.
body.zh: 标题栏图标改用主题强调色，在深色主题下也清晰可见。

title.en: Two projects with similar paths no longer share sessions
title.zh: 路径相近的两个项目不再共用会话

body.en: Workspace roots such as front-end/app and front/end-app mapped to the same project folder, so a session saved in one could appear in the other. A newly added project that collides now gets its own folder; existing projects keep theirs.
body.zh: 像 front-end/app 与 front/end-app 这样的工作区会映射到同一个项目目录，一个项目里保存的会话可能出现在另一个项目中。现在新添加的项目若发生冲突会使用独立目录，已有项目保持不变。

title.en: Archiving an old conversation archives all its versions
title.zh: 归档旧会话时一并归档它的所有版本

body.en: Archiving a conversation from an older version left its other versions in the sidebar, so it looked like the row kept coming back. All versions are now archived together.
body.zh: 归档旧版本留下的会话时，它的其他版本仍留在侧边栏，看起来像是归档后又出现。现在会一并归档所有版本。

title.en: Updating an old Linux portable install restores the previous release on failure
title.zh: 旧版 Linux 便携安装升级失败时恢复原版本

body.en: Updaters from 1.18 to 1.19.2 on the Linux portable install could unpack an incomplete update. The migrator now refuses it and restores the previous release instead of leaving a broken install.
body.zh: Linux 便携版 1.18 至 1.19.2 的更新程序可能只解出部分文件。现在迁移程序会拒绝这种不完整的更新并恢复原版本，不再留下无法启动的安装。

title.en: Project configuration can only narrow your settings
title.zh: 项目配置只能收紧你的设置

body.en: A repository's reasonix.toml and .reasonix/settings.json can no longer loosen the sandbox, permissions or approval settings; a project may only make them stricter. Programs a project declares (hooks, language servers, providers, the shell, ripgrep and browser paths) wait for your approval before first use, and a changed declaration or file asks again. "Always allow" answers given in a project are kept in your Reasonix home rather than in the repository.
body.zh: 仓库里的 reasonix.toml 和 .reasonix/settings.json 不能再放宽沙盒、权限和审批设置，只能让它们更严格。项目声明的程序（钩子、语言服务器、模型服务商、shell、ripgrep 和浏览器路径）首次使用前需要你批准，声明或相关文件变化后会再次询问。在项目里选择的「总是允许」改为保存在你的 Reasonix 主目录，而不是写进仓库。

title.en: Compaction has a time limit and keeps your context on failure
title.zh: 上下文整理有时间上限，失败时保留原有上下文

body.en: Compacting a near-full conversation could wait indefinitely because server heartbeats kept the request alive. Each compaction now has one five-minute deadline, and a failed summary keeps the last committed context instead of falling back to a lossy truncation.
body.zh: 接近上限的对话在整理时可能无限等待，因为服务端心跳一直让请求保持活跃。现在每次整理有统一的五分钟上限；摘要失败时保留最后一次确认的上下文，不再退回有损截断。

summary.en: Security hardening for project configuration and the sandbox, compaction that no longer waits indefinitely, and desktop fixes.
summary.zh: 项目配置与沙盒的安全加固、上下文整理不再无限等待，以及若干桌面端修复。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.5

title.en: Programs a project declares need approval once
title.zh: 项目声明的程序需要批准一次

body.en: Hooks, language servers, providers, tools.shell.path, tools.search.rg_path and [browser] settings from a project's reasonix.toml or .reasonix/settings.json stay off until you approve them: run reasonix trust in the project (reasonix trust --yes to approve), or approve hooks in the desktop hooks settings. Model settings that named only an unapproved project provider fall back to your own.
body.zh: 项目 reasonix.toml 或 .reasonix/settings.json 里声明的钩子、语言服务器、模型服务商、tools.shell.path、tools.search.rg_path 和 [browser] 设置，在你批准前不会生效：在项目目录运行 reasonix trust 查看（reasonix trust --yes 批准），或在桌面端的钩子设置里批准。只指向未批准项目服务商的模型设置会回落到你自己的设置。

title.zh: 批准按文件夹分别记录

body.en: Each worktree and each other folder of the same repository needs its own approval.
body.zh: 同一仓库的每个工作树、每个其他文件夹都需要分别批准。

title.en: Program paths inside the workspace are no longer accepted
title.zh: 不再接受位于工作区内的程序路径

body.en: tools.shell.path, tools.search.rg_path and browser.chrome_path may not point into the workspace, a temporary directory, an allow_write directory or a toolchain cache. Point them at an installed program instead.
body.zh: tools.shell.path、tools.search.rg_path 和 browser.chrome_path 不能再指向工作区、临时目录、allow_write 目录或工具链缓存里的程序，请改为指向已安装的程序。

title.en: Sandbox, permission and proxy settings are read from your own config
title.zh: 沙盒、权限和代理设置只取你自己的配置

body.en: A project can only make [sandbox] and [permissions] stricter; permissions.mode, allow, allow_dynamic_bash, [network] proxy settings and the default tool approval mode come from your user config. Settings a project can no longer apply are listed as load warnings.
body.zh: 项目只能让 [sandbox] 和 [permissions] 更严格；permissions.mode、allow、allow_dynamic_bash、[network] 代理设置和默认工具审批模式都取自你的用户配置。项目里不再生效的设置会在加载时以警告列出。

title.en: The bot reads only your own config
title.zh: 机器人只读取你自己的配置

body.en: The [bot] section of a project's reasonix.toml is no longer read, and the desktop no longer copies a project's reasonix.toml into your config. Move bot settings into your user config.
body.zh: 不再读取项目 reasonix.toml 里的 [bot] 段，桌面端也不再把项目的 reasonix.toml 合并进你的配置。请把机器人设置移到用户配置中。

title.en: Permission rules that name no tool are flagged
title.zh: 提示匹配不到任何工具的权限规则

body.en: A rule written as a bare command, such as deny = ["rm"], parses but never matches a tool call. Such rules are now pointed out at startup with the Bash(...) form they should use; matching is unchanged.
body.zh: 写成裸命令的规则（例如 deny = ["rm"]）能被解析，但永远匹配不到任何工具调用。现在启动时会指出这类规则，并给出应写成的 Bash(...) 形式；匹配语义不变。

title.en: Saving a new key keeps the variable name you chose
title.zh: 保存新密钥时保留你设置的变量名

body.en: When a provider's key lives under a name only that provider reads, saving a new key now updates that variable in place instead of moving the provider to a private slot and leaving the old value behind. The previous value is kept until the save completes, so an interrupted save restores it.
body.zh: 当某个模型服务的密钥存放在只有它读取的变量名下时，保存新密钥现在会就地更新该变量，不再把服务挪到私有槽位、把旧值留在原处。保存完成前会保留旧值，中途中断会恢复。

title.en: Remote SSH tabs show their context in the session overview
title.zh: SSH 远程标签页的会话概览显示上下文

body.en: The right-hand overview of a remote tab showed empty context data even while the remote Serve reported usage. It now reads the selected remote session's context and drops responses that race a session switch.
body.zh: 远程标签页右侧概览在远端 Serve 已有用量时仍显示为空。现在会读取所选远程会话的上下文，并丢弃与切换会话竞争的过期响应。

title.en: A turn that stops for delivery checks rings the attention chime
title.zh: 因交付检查而停下的轮次会播放提醒音

body.en: A turn ending because delivery checks were incomplete played no sound. It now rings the attention chime, like other pauses that wait on you.
body.zh: 因交付检查未完成而结束的轮次之前没有任何提示音。现在会像其他等待你处理的暂停一样播放提醒音。

title.en: Dropping a session on a group member adds it to that group
title.zh: 把会话拖到分组成员上会加入该分组

body.en: Dropping a session onto a member row of a session group only reordered it, so a session dragged in from outside stayed outside. It now joins the group.
body.zh: 把会话拖到会话分组的成员行上只会调整顺序，从组外拖进来的会话仍在组外。现在会加入该分组。

title.en: Retrying an MCP server in /mcp no longer freezes the chat
title.zh: 在 /mcp 里重试 MCP 服务不再卡住整个对话

body.en: Choosing Retry on a server that failed to connect ran the handshake on the UI loop, so an unresponsive server froze keys and redraw for up to its startup timeout. The connect now runs in the background.
body.zh: 对连接失败的服务选择「重试」时，握手在界面循环里同步执行，服务无响应时按键和重绘会卡住直到启动超时。现在连接在后台进行。

title.en: Review sub-agents are no longer stopped after eight rounds
title.zh: 审查类子代理不再在 8 轮后被停下

body.en: Review, security-review and team-architect sub-agents paused after 8 tool-call rounds with a message to raise max_steps, which no setting reached. They now get the same step budget as other sub-agents.
body.zh: review、security-review、team-architect 子代理在 8 轮工具调用后就会暂停，并提示调大 max_steps，但没有任何设置能调到。现在它们与其他子代理使用相同的步数预算。

summary.en: Fixes for the CLI and desktop: /mcp retries no longer freeze the chat, review sub-agents run to completion, rotated keys keep their variable name, and remote tabs show their context.
summary.zh: CLI 与桌面端修复：/mcp 重试不再卡住对话、审查子代理不再被 8 轮上限打断、更换密钥保留原变量名、远程标签页显示上下文。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.4

title.en: ACP turns keep the skill input you typed
title.zh: ACP 对话保留你输入的技能调用原文

body.en: An inline skill invocation sent through ACP now reaches the turn as the text you typed instead of the rendered skill body, matching the CLI and desktop.
body.zh: 通过 ACP 发送的行内技能调用，现在以你输入的原文进入本轮，而不是渲染后的技能正文，与 CLI 和桌面端一致。

title.en: Safer project configuration, serve approvals, host git and sandbox
title.zh: 项目配置、serve 审批、宿主 git 与沙盒的安全加固

body.en: MCP servers declared by a project now wait for your approval before they start, and a project can no longer set the status-line command. Changes and approvals through serve require the launch token. Git commands Reasonix runs itself no longer execute programs configured by the repository, and inside the bash sandbox the repository's git config and hooks stay read-only.
body.zh: 项目声明的 MCP 服务在启动前会先征得你的同意，项目也不能再设置状态栏命令；通过 serve 进行的修改与审批需要本次启动的令牌；Reasonix 自己执行的 git 命令不再运行仓库配置的程序；在 bash 沙盒内，仓库的 git 配置与钩子保持只读。

title.en: Remote SSH sessions load and send again
title.zh: 远程 SSH 会话恢复正常加载与发送

body.en: After a historical session had been opened on a remote host, later connections reported "transcript v2 is required" or "Transcript v2 is not synchronized" and could not load or send. The remote Serve now always announces the capability it supports. After updating, reconnect once: the desktop restarts the remote Serve and replaces its binary automatically.
body.zh: 在远端打开过一次旧的历史会话后，之后的连接会报 "transcript v2 is required" 或 "Transcript v2 is not synchronized"，无法加载也无法发送。现在远端 Serve 会始终如实声明它支持的能力。更新后重连一次，桌面端会自动重启远端 Serve 并替换其程序。

summary.en: Security hardening for project configuration, serve approvals, host git and the sandbox, and remote SSH sessions that load and send again.
summary.zh: 项目配置、serve 审批、宿主 git 与沙盒的安全加固，以及远程 SSH 会话恢复正常加载与发送。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.3
Reasonix 1.39.2

summary.en: Fixes for desktop and CLI: sessions that could not be opened or archived, live streaming after switching sessions, typed skill invocations, the setup API key name, and readable output on Chinese Windows.
summary.zh: 桌面端与 CLI 修复：打不开或归档不掉的会话、切换会话后的实时流式显示、手动调用技能、设置向导的 API Key 变量名，以及中文 Windows 上的输出乱码。

title.en: Sessions that could not be opened or trashed work again
title.zh: 打不开、也删不掉的会话恢复正常

body.en: A session whose history recorded the same message twice failed to open and could not be moved to the Trash, showing only a generic error. It now opens (the first copy of the message wins; the file on disk is not rewritten), a damaged session can always be moved to the Trash with a clear message, and new writes can no longer record a duplicate.
body.zh: 历史里同一条消息被记录两次的会话会打不开，也无法移到废纸篓，只提示一个笼统的错误。现在这类会话可以正常打开（以第一条为准，磁盘上的文件不会被改写）；文件损坏的会话也总能移到废纸篓，并给出明确提示；新的写入也不会再产生重复消息。

title.en: Old sessions you archive leave the sidebar
title.zh: 归档的旧会话会从侧栏消失

body.en: Archiving a recovered 1.38 conversation now archives every recovered copy at once instead of the next copy taking its place, and a legacy row listed under the wrong workspace (branch-badged rows, or rows titled with a raw file name) no longer stays stuck in the sidebar refusing pin, rename and open. Everything archived stays restorable from the archive list.
body.zh: 归档 1.38 留下的「已恢复」旧会话时，会一次归档它的所有恢复副本，不会再归档一条又冒出下一条；被列在错误工作区下的旧会话（带分支标记的、或以原始文件名为标题的）也不会再卡在侧栏、既删不掉又不能置顶/重命名/打开。归档的内容都可以在归档列表里恢复。

title.en: Replies stream live again after switching sessions
title.zh: 切换会话后回复重新实时流式显示

body.en: A session opened from an older topic path, for example by switching to it in the sidebar, showed no thinking or answer until the turn ended. Output now streams as it arrives, as it does in the CLI.
body.zh: 从旧话题路径打开的会话（例如在侧栏切换过去）在整轮结束前看不到任何思考或回答。现在会像 CLI 一样边生成边显示。

title.en: Earlier history loads after the cache is cleared
title.zh: 缓存清理后仍能加载更早的历史

body.en: Scrolling up for older messages in a long session no longer fails, with retry stuck, after the session cache was evicted and the session had changed since the tab opened.
body.zh: 长会话里向上翻加载更早消息时，如果会话缓存已被清理且会话在打开后有过变化，不会再加载失败、重试也无效。

title.en: Typed skill invocations reach the model the same way every time
title.zh: 手动调用技能时，模型收到的内容与工具调用一致

body.en: A message that is just /name (or a lone skill chip in the desktop composer) now sends the skill exactly as run_skill does, with your arguments labelled. Routing reads what you typed rather than the skill's body, so a skill that mentions another one no longer makes the model load both, and wording such as "use X skill" in the middle of a sentence no longer forces a skill.
body.zh: 只包含 /技能名 的消息（或桌面端输入框里单独的技能标签）现在与 run_skill 以同一种形式发给模型，你输入的参数也会单独标出。技能路由按你实际输入的内容判断，而不是技能正文：一个技能正文里提到另一个技能时，不会再让模型把两个都加载；句子中间出现「用 X 技能」之类的说法也不会再强制调用技能。

title.en: Setup keeps the API key variable name you type
title.zh: reasonix setup 保留你输入的 API Key 变量名

body.en: The setup wizard asked for an API key variable name but always saved the key under a generated REASONIX_CONNECTION_…_KEY name. The name you type is now used. If another provider, setting or your environment already uses that variable, setup says what holds it and asks again; pressing Enter still lets Reasonix choose a private name.
body.zh: 设置向导会询问 API Key 变量名，但此前总是把密钥存到自动生成的 REASONIX_CONNECTION_…_KEY 里。现在会使用你输入的名字；如果该变量已被其他提供方、配置项或环境占用，向导会说明被谁占用并请你重新输入；直接回车仍由 Reasonix 自动选择一个私有名字。

title.en: The context panel's runtime keeps counting during long tool runs
title.zh: 上下文面板的运行时间在长时间工具执行中持续计时

body.en: Runtime in the context panel and the context ring no longer freezes between model requests, so long sessions show their real running time.
body.zh: 上下文面板和上下文环里的运行时间不再在两次模型请求之间停住，长会话显示的是真实运行时长。

title.en: History search finds text in tool output
title.zh: 历史搜索能找到工具输出里的内容

body.en: Content search in the history panel now matches tool results, such as a failed MCP server listing, and reads each session once instead of once per hit.
body.zh: 历史面板的内容搜索现在也会匹配工具结果（例如 MCP 服务器列表失败的输出），并且每个会话只读取一次。

title.en: The sidebar says it is reading projects on a slow start
title.zh: 启动较慢时侧栏会提示正在读取项目

body.en: Instead of briefly showing "No projects yet" before the project list arrives, the sidebar shows a loading state.
body.zh: 项目列表返回之前，侧栏显示加载状态，而不是先闪一下「还没有项目」。

title.en: Symlinks inside the workspace appear in the file panel
title.zh: 工作区内的符号链接会显示在文件面板中

body.en: The file panel and the @ menu list a link whose target stays inside the workspace; links that dangle or point outside it are left out and cannot be previewed.
body.zh: 文件面板和 @ 菜单会列出目标仍在工作区内的符号链接；悬空或指向工作区外的链接不显示，也无法预览。

title.en: Reopened sessions stay fast to read
title.zh: 重新打开的会话读取保持快速

body.en: After a session is reopened, new messages keep its on-disk index current, so later reads no longer rebuild it from the full log.
body.zh: 会话重新打开后，新消息会同步更新磁盘上的索引，之后读取不再从完整日志重建。

title.en: Sandbox denials in a Git worktree say which folders to allow
title.zh: Git worktree 中的沙箱拒绝会提示该放行哪些目录

body.en: When git add fails in a linked worktree because the sandbox blocks the main repository's Git metadata, bash now suggests the narrow folders to approve, never the whole .git directory.
body.zh: 在关联的 Git worktree 中，git add 因沙箱拦截主仓库的 Git 元数据而失败时，bash 会提示需要放行的最小目录，绝不会建议放行整个 .git 目录。

title.en: The environment note tells the tool shell from your login shell
title.zh: 环境说明区分工具 shell 与你的登录 shell

body.en: When your login shell is fish or zsh, the model is told that its bash tool still runs bash, so shell advice matches where commands actually run.
body.zh: 当你的登录 shell 是 fish 或 zsh 时，模型会知道它的 bash 工具仍然运行在 bash 中，给出的 shell 建议与实际执行环境一致。

title.en: A remote Ask card shows once and can be answered
title.zh: 远程 Ask 卡片只显示一次且可以提交

body.en: In an SSH remote workspace, a question from the agent appeared twice and neither card could be submitted. It now appears once and submits.
body.zh: 在 SSH 远程工作区里，智能体的提问会出现两张卡片且都无法提交。现在只显示一张，并能正常提交。

title.en: SSH projects stay out of the composer's local folder menu
title.zh: SSH 项目不再出现在输入框上方的本地文件夹菜单里

body.en: Pinned SSH projects were listed as local folders and failed when picked. They remain reachable from the sidebar's remote group.
body.zh: 已固定的 SSH 项目曾被当作本地文件夹列出，选中就报错。现在它们只在侧栏的远程分组中出现。

title.en: A waiting approval or question notifies once
title.zh: 等待中的审批或提问只通知一次

body.en: System notifications and bot-watched chats no longer repeat the same approval or question each time the desktop re-syncs a tab.
body.zh: 桌面端每次重新同步标签页时，系统通知和机器人监听的聊天不会再重复推送同一个审批或提问。

title.en: Writes to the session's own temp folder no longer ask for scope
title.zh: 写入会话自己的临时目录不再请求扩大范围

body.en: write_file to the app-owned session temp directory stops prompting on every call; other directories still go through the normal approval.
body.zh: write_file 写入应用自有的会话临时目录时不再每次都弹出扩大写入范围的请求；其他目录仍走正常审批。

title.en: A single ~ is no longer strikethrough
title.zh: 单个 ~ 不再被渲染成删除线

body.en: Ranges such as 500~1000 render as written; ~~text~~ still strikes through.
body.zh: 像 500~1000 这样的范围按原样显示；~~文字~~ 仍是删除线。

title.en: File edits keep untouched bytes in UTF-8 files with CJK text
title.zh: 编辑含中日韩文字的 UTF-8 文件不再改动未编辑的字节

body.en: edit_file and related tools could rewrite characters far from the edit when a file had a stray invalid byte. A file is now treated as GB18030 or GBK only when that reading round-trips exactly.
body.zh: 文件中有个别无效字节时，edit_file 等工具可能改写远离编辑处的字符。现在只有能原样往返时才把文件当作 GB18030 或 GBK 处理。

title.en: Command and MCP output on Chinese Windows is readable
title.zh: 中文 Windows 上的命令输出和 MCP 报错可以正常阅读

body.en: Output from bash tool commands and MCP server startup errors written in the console code page is decoded instead of turning into mojibake, and output cut in the middle of a UTF-8 character no longer reads as garbled text.
body.zh: bash 工具命令的输出和 MCP 服务器启动报错按控制台代码页正确解码，不再是乱码；在 UTF-8 字符中间被截断的输出也不会再整体显示成乱码。

title.en: Tool calls through Responses relays run
title.zh: 经 Responses 中转的工具调用能正常执行

body.en: When a relay drops the per-call done events, the tool calls listed in the completed response are now run instead of the turn ending early.
body.zh: 中转服务丢掉单个工具调用的完成事件时，现在会按完成响应里列出的调用继续执行，而不是提前结束这一轮。

title.en: StepFun presets know their context window
title.zh: StepFun 预设带上上下文窗口

body.en: StepFun models now show the context gauge and compact automatically at their 262144-token limit; existing StepFun entries without a window are updated.
body.zh: StepFun 模型现在会显示上下文用量，并按 262144 token 的上限自动压缩；已安装但没有设置窗口的 StepFun 配置会自动补上。

title.en: Subagents stay on the provider you picked
title.zh: 子代理留在你选择的提供方上

body.en: A subagent model named without a provider now runs on the parent session's provider when it serves that model, instead of the first provider that lists it.
body.zh: 只写模型名、不带提供方的子代理，现在会在父会话的提供方支持该模型时留在同一提供方，而不是跑到第一个列出它的提供方。

title.en: OpenCode Go minimax-m2.7 uses the route it is served on
title.zh: OpenCode Go 的 minimax-m2.7 走正确的接口

body.en: minimax-m2.7 is offered only on the Anthropic route, where OpenCode Go serves it.
body.zh: minimax-m2.7 只在 OpenCode Go 实际提供它的 Anthropic 接口上出现。

title.zh: web_fetch 在 fake-ip 代理下可用

body.en: With Clash or mihomo in fake-ip mode, web_fetch no longer refuses every public site; it connects to an allowed address and still refuses hosts that resolve only to internal ones.
body.zh: 在 Clash 或 mihomo 的 fake-ip 模式下，web_fetch 不再拒绝所有公网站点；它会连接允许的地址，只解析到内网地址的主机仍会被拒绝。

title.en: Projects under a cloud-drive folder load their config
title.zh: 云盘目录下的项目能正常加载配置

body.en: On Windows, a workspace inside a Box Drive or similar mount no longer fails every config load with a path error.
body.zh: 在 Windows 上，位于 Box Drive 等云盘挂载目录中的工作区不再每次加载配置都报路径错误。

title.en: Quoted text wraps within the terminal
title.zh: 引用文字在终端宽度内换行

body.en: Long blockquotes in the CLI chat, especially CJK text, no longer overflow the terminal and leave a stray rail on the next row.
body.zh: CLI 对话里的长引用（尤其是中文）不再超出终端宽度、在下一行留下多余的竖线。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.1

summary.en: Stability fixes for desktop and CLI: sessions missing after an update, the Windows window that never opened, older-session import, hooks everywhere tools run, and memory safety.
summary.zh: 桌面端与 CLI 的稳定性修复：更新后会话「消失」、Windows 窗口打不开、旧会话导入、钩子覆盖所有工具调用处，以及记忆安全。

title.en: Sessions missing after an update are back
title.zh: 更新后会话「消失」的问题已修复

body.en: After updating from 1.38 the sidebar could show no sessions at all, or open on a startup error when the last tab was a chat that was never sent. Both are fixed, and the session catalog repair rebuilds a list that lost sessions with branches. The conversations themselves were never deleted.
body.zh: 从 1.38 升级后，侧栏可能一条会话都不显示；如果上次停留在一个没发过消息的新对话上，还会一启动就报错。两者都已修复，会话目录的启动修复也会找回带分支会话的列表。会话内容本身一直都在。

title.en: The window opens again on Windows machines that ran the 1.38 sandbox
title.zh: 用过 1.38 沙箱的 Windows 电脑上窗口能正常打开了

body.en: The Windows sandbox in 1.38.8–1.38.10 could leave an access entry on the install folder that made every Chromium process crash, so the window never appeared. The desktop app now removes those entries from its own install folder at startup, and says so if Windows refuses.
body.zh: 1.38.8–1.38.10 的 Windows 沙箱可能在安装目录上留下一条访问权限，导致 Chromium 进程全部崩溃、窗口始终不出现。桌面端现在启动时会从自己的安装目录移除这类权限，被系统拒绝时会弹窗说明原因。

title.en: Opening and importing older sessions keeps their original files
title.zh: 打开和导入旧会话不再改动原始文件

body.en: An older session opened from the sidebar no longer adds a second row named after its file, and importing it leaves the original files untouched instead of reporting that the source changed.
body.zh: 从侧栏打开旧会话不再多出一行以文件名命名的重复条目；导入时原始文件保持不变，也不会再误报「旧来源有更新」。

title.en: IME Enter no longer closes rename inputs
title.zh: 输入法回车不再关闭重命名输入框

body.en: Session rename inputs stay open when a Chinese IME uses Enter to finish composition, preserving the saved title.
body.zh: 当中文输入法使用回车结束组合时，会话重命名输入框保持打开，保留已保存的标题。

title.en: Memory operations preserve index on read failure
title.zh: 读取失败时记忆操作保留索引

body.en: Unreadable MEMORY.md no longer causes save or archive to erase managed entries and hand-written notes.
body.zh: 不可读的 MEMORY.md 不再导致保存或归档清除受管条目和手写笔记。

title.en: Tool hooks run wherever tools run
title.zh: 工具钩子覆盖所有调用工具的地方

body.en: Project and global tool hooks now also apply to subagents (task, read_only_task, run_skill, read_only_skill), the planner, reasonix review and the desktop try run, and a resumed skill keeps the same hook session id.
body.zh: 项目和全局工具钩子现在也作用于子代理（task、read_only_task、run_skill、read_only_skill）、规划器、reasonix review 和桌面端试运行；续跑的技能保持同一个钩子会话 ID。

title.en: Long provider model names fit within two lines
title.zh: 长提供方模型名称在两行内显示

body.en: Clamp displayed model names to two lines and expose the full name on hover.
body.zh: 将显示的模型名称限制为两行，并在悬停时显示完整名称。

title.zh: 模糊的 --resume 查询列出匹配项

body.en: Headless resume with multiple matches now lists candidates and suggests using --resume <id>.
body.zh: 无头恢复遇到多个匹配时，现在会列出候选项并建议使用 --resume <id>。

title.zh: 崩溃覆盖层可重启 Reasonix

body.en: Add a Restart Reasonix action to the crash overlay, with fallback to page reload.
body.zh: 在崩溃覆盖层添加“重启 Reasonix”操作，并回退到页面重新加载。

title.en: File panel shows top-level tmp/, bin/, stage/
title.zh: 文件面板显示顶层 tmp/、bin/、stage/

body.en: Workspace file panel and watcher no longer hide these directories.
body.zh: 工作区文件面板和监视器不再隐藏这些目录。

title.en: Fatal crash output captured for long sessions
title.zh: 长会话的致命崩溃输出被捕获

body.en: Runtime crash output goes to a per-PID file, and diagnostic logs rotate to keep the newest entries.
body.zh: 运行时崩溃输出写入每个 PID 的文件，诊断日志轮转以保留最新条目。

title.en: Provider error visible on interrupted turns
title.zh: 中断轮次显示提供方错误

body.en: Interrupted turns with provider errors now show the error text instead of only a generic notice.
body.zh: 带有提供方错误的中断轮次现在显示错误文本，而不仅仅是通用通知。

title.en: Context overflow detection for input length errors
title.zh: 输入长度错误的上下文溢出检测

body.en: Recognize 'Input length exceeds maximum' as a context overflow, triggering compaction.
body.zh: 将“输入长度超过最大值”识别为上下文溢出，触发压缩。

title.en: One-shot reasonix -p runs stay out of the sidebar
title.zh: 一次性的 reasonix -p 运行不再出现在侧栏

body.en: Headless runs, including ones an agent launches, no longer leave permanent sidebar rows named with a raw id.
body.zh: 无头运行（包括智能体自己启动的）不再在侧栏留下以原始 ID 命名的永久条目。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.39.0

summary.en: This release improves conversation recovery, error handling, and session management for a smoother desktop experience.
summary.zh: 此版本改进了会话恢复、错误处理和会话管理，带来更流畅的桌面体验。

title.zh: 恢复指南

body.en: Learn how Reasonix recovers blocked conversations and handles missing data.
body.zh: 了解 Reasonix 如何恢复被阻塞的会话并处理缺失数据。

title.zh: 错误呈现指南

body.en: Understand how errors are summarized and localized across the desktop app.
body.zh: 了解错误如何在桌面应用中汇总和本地化。

title.zh: 更强大的会话恢复能力

body.en: Conversations blocked by invalid tool arguments or missing images now recover automatically, with localized guidance when user action is needed.
body.zh: 因无效工具参数或缺失图像而阻塞的会话现在可自动恢复，并在需要用户操作时提供本地化指导。

title.zh: 更快、更清晰的供应商错误

body.en: Ordinary provider HTTP and network failures no longer enter long automatic retry loops; the app shows localized error summaries.
body.zh: 普通供应商 HTTP 和网络故障不再进入长时间自动重试；应用会显示本地化错误摘要。

title.en: No more ghost sessions after deletion
title.zh: 删除后不再出现幽灵会话

body.en: Permanently deleting archived sessions no longer leaves behind phantom sidebar rows.
body.zh: 永久删除归档会话后，不再留下幽灵侧边栏行。

title.zh: 更整洁的转录指导行

body.en: Queued guidance now appears as a single transcript row, with exact text preserved.
body.zh: 队列指导现在显示为单个转录行，并保留精确文本。

title.zh: 会话标题栏改进

body.en: Long session names stay compact with full name on hover, and renames target the correct session.
body.zh: 长会话名称保持紧凑，悬停显示全名，重命名针对正确的会话。

title.en: Desktop stability, session lifecycle, and performance improvements
title.zh: 桌面稳定性、会话生命周期与性能改进

summary.en: This release focuses on fixing session creation, navigation, and lifecycle issues, improving performance, and enhancing the overall desktop experience.
summary.zh: 此版本重点修复会话创建、导航和生命周期问题，提升性能，并改善整体桌面体验。

title.zh: 浏览器运行时升级

body.en: Learn about the upgraded browser runtime, including new capabilities and diagnostic improvements.
body.zh: 了解升级后的浏览器运行时，包括新功能和诊断改进。

title.zh: 编辑器控制

body.en: Documentation for the composer controls, including queue editing and guidance.
body.zh: 编辑器控制文档，包括队列编辑和引导。

title.zh: 模型设置

body.en: Details on model settings, runtime validation, and background gateway preservation.
body.zh: 模型设置、运行时验证和后台网关保留的详细信息。

title.zh: 读取快照分页

body.en: How bounded read snapshots stabilize session list pagination.
body.zh: 有界读取快照如何稳定会话列表分页。

title.zh: Windows Agent Shell

body.en: Restored Git Bash and shell settings on Windows.
body.zh: 在 Windows 上恢复 Git Bash 和 Shell 设置。

title.zh: 历史启动加载

body.en: Deferred historical session loading and bounded native paging.
body.zh: 延迟历史会话加载和有界原生分页。

title.en: Consistent project sidebar and session navigation
title.zh: 修复项目侧栏与会话切换一致性

body.en: Removing and re-adding a workspace restores its visibility, stale sidebar reads cannot hide current conversations, and native history opens through the canonical session identity.
body.zh: 移除后重新添加项目可恢复侧栏可见性，过期读取不再覆盖当前会话列表，原生历史记录可通过统一会话身份正常打开。

title.zh: 简化会话创建与恢复

body.en: New Session no longer fails with target_changed, shows unrelated recovery failures, or leaves stale input visible. Creation feedback now belongs to the selected conversation.
body.zh: 新建会话不再出现 target_changed 错误、无关恢复失败或残留输入。创建反馈现在归属于所选会话。

title.zh: 修复历史会话协调

body.en: Old-format conversations open directly, and adopted sources no longer appear as duplicate unusable rows.
body.zh: 旧格式会话可直接打开，已采用的源不再显示为重复的不可用行。

title.en: Faster startup with deferred history loading
title.zh: 延迟历史加载，启动更快

body.en: Historical session loading is removed from the startup critical path, with bounded background discovery and native paging.
body.zh: 历史会话加载从启动关键路径中移除，采用有界后台发现和原生分页。

title.zh: 消除会话生命周期死锁

body.en: Fixed hangs caused by cleanup racing with preview operations, AI renaming, and autosave completion.
body.zh: 修复了清理与预览操作、AI 重命名和自动保存完成竞争导致的挂起。

title.zh: 稳定的会话列表分页

body.en: Bounded read snapshots prevent stale cursor errors and keep pagination stable during metadata updates.
body.zh: 有界读取快照防止过期游标错误，并在元数据更新期间保持分页稳定。

title.en: Background gateways preserved through model changes
title.zh: 模型更改后保留后台网关

body.en: Saving model settings no longer blocks subsequent messages when background jobs are running.
body.zh: 保存模型设置不再在后台任务运行时阻塞后续消息。

title.zh: 编辑并调整待处理消息顺序

body.en: Queued messages can be edited in place and reordered with pointer or keyboard.
body.zh: 待处理消息可就地编辑，并可用指针或键盘调整顺序。

title.zh: 原生图形故障恢复

body.en: Desktop offers a native recovery dialog for repeated GPU failures or persistent stalls.
body.zh: 桌面端为重复的 GPU 故障或持续卡顿提供原生恢复对话框。

title.zh: 统一内置 HTML 预览

body.en: Local HTML files open in a task-bound built-in browser tab with responsive workspace delivery.
body.zh: 本地 HTML 文件在任务绑定的内置浏览器标签页中打开，并支持响应式工作区交付。

title.en: Refresh DeepSeek and MiMo model choices
title.zh: 更新 DeepSeek 与 MiMo 模型选项

body.en: New official DeepSeek connections use deepseek-flash. MiMo distinguishes API access from Token Plan and adds V2.6 Pro and Flash while preserving existing defaults and user choices.
body.zh: 新建 DeepSeek 官方连接默认使用 deepseek-flash。MiMo 明确区分 API 与 Token Plan，并加入 V2.6 Pro、Flash，同时保留已有默认模型和用户选择。

title.zh: 升级内置浏览器运行时

body.en: Browser actions retain their owning session and frame, capability status reflects the bound runtime, and diagnostic exports make browser failures easier to investigate.
body.zh: 浏览器操作保留所属会话与页面框架，能力状态与实际绑定的运行时一致，并提供诊断导出以排查浏览器故障。

title.zh: 减少聊天区重复渲染

body.en: Streaming no longer invalidates unchanged transcript rows, reducing renderer long tasks.
body.zh: 流式输出不再使未更改的聊天记录行失效，减少渲染器长任务。

title.zh: 侧栏刷新更安静

body.en: Background refreshes no longer flash loading indicators when a resident page exists.
body.zh: 当存在常驻页面时，后台刷新不再闪烁加载指示器。

title.zh: 简化归档会话管理

body.en: Archive page uses a responsive list/preview layout with Restore as primary action.
body.zh: 归档页面采用响应式列表/预览布局，恢复为主要操作。

title.zh: 恢复完整会话轮次导航

body.en: Turn rail now includes all conversation turns with bounded paging.
body.zh: 轮次导航栏现在包含所有会话轮次，并支持有界分页。

title.en: Reduced history and multi-session resource usage
title.zh: 降低历史会话与多会话资源占用

body.en: Caching and coalescing reduce repeated work during session switches.
body.zh: 缓存和合并减少会话切换期间的重复工作。

title.zh: 延迟会话加载提示

body.en: Fast conversation switches no longer flash a loading surface.
body.zh: 快速会话切换不再闪烁加载界面。

title.en: Restore Windows shell and path compatibility
title.zh: 恢复 Windows Shell 与路径兼容性

body.en: Restore Git Bash and shell settings, and normalize junction paths consistently so equivalent workspace paths do not disrupt upgrade recovery.
body.zh: 恢复 Git Bash 与 Shell 设置，并统一 Junction 路径身份，避免同一项目的等价路径干扰升级恢复。

title.en: Repair manual compaction and duplicate admission
title.zh: 修复手动压缩与重复提交

body.en: Manual compaction correctly identifies compressible history, reports progress, and rejects duplicate admission without losing session-bound receipts. Cancellation does not commit a new summary projection.
body.zh: 手动压缩正确识别可压缩历史并显示进度，阻止重复提交且保留所属会话回执；取消操作不再提交新的摘要投影。

title.en: Preserve pending guidance and shutdown recovery
title.zh: 保留待处理消息与关闭恢复状态

body.en: Queued guidance, completion receipts, and recovered tool results remain attached to their owning conversation. History lifecycle and shutdown recovery retain the original session records.
body.zh: 待处理消息、完成回执及恢复后的工具结果保持归属于原会话；历史生命周期和关闭恢复保留原始会话记录。

title.en: Repair retained historical archives and branches
title.zh: 修复残留历史归档与分支

body.en: Historical branches and retained archives reconcile with canonical conversations, while retired sources stay out of the sidebar and session recovery avoids duplicate identities.
body.zh: 历史分支与残留归档和正式会话保持一致，已退役来源不再出现在侧栏，会话恢复避免产生重复身份。

title.zh: 保持 macOS Dock 图标比例

body.en: The packaged macOS app keeps the intended icon scale in the Dock.
body.zh: macOS 安装包中的应用图标在 Dock 中保持预期缩放比例。

title.zh: 修复切换会话后的速率异常飙升

body.en: Restored sessions now measure output against matching provider-active intervals.
body.zh: 恢复的会话现在根据匹配的提供程序活动间隔测量输出。

title.zh: 修复概览上下文与用量串会话

body.en: Context usage no longer leaks from the previous session.
body.zh: 上下文用量不再从上一个会话泄漏。

title.zh: 防止清空回收站后的幽灵会话

body.en: Emptying trash no longer creates ghost rows for purged sessions.
body.zh: 清空回收站不再为已清除的会话创建幽灵行。

title.zh: 修复连续分叉后侧栏未显示

body.en: Repeated forks from the same source now appear in the sidebar without restart.
body.zh: 来自同一来源的连续分叉现在无需重启即可显示在侧栏中。

title.en: Running transcript order after tab return
title.zh: 修复切回运行中会话时思考错序

body.en: Reasoning no longer appears above the user message when returning to a running conversation.
body.zh: 返回运行中的会话时，推理不再显示在用户消息上方。

title.zh: 修复任务完成后工具结果重复显示

body.en: Completed tool calls no longer reappear below the final answer.
body.zh: 已完成的工具调用不再出现在最终答案下方。

title.zh: 主动压缩会更新会话上下文

body.en: Running /compact now performs the requested fold even when automatic compaction is disabled. This explicit action can replace the cached conversation prefix; automatic thresholds are unchanged.
body.zh: 即使关闭自动压缩，主动执行 /compact 也会按要求压缩历史，因此可能替换已缓存的会话前缀；自动压缩阈值保持不变。

title.zh: 旧草稿已停用

body.en: The old workspace draft workflow is removed. Existing formal histories and unsent input remain intact.
body.zh: 旧的工作区草稿工作流已移除。现有的正式历史记录和未发送输入保持不变。

title.zh: 恢复即时会话创建

body.en: New Conversation now creates an independent formal session immediately, with upgrade-safe input recovery.
body.zh: 新建会话现在立即创建独立的正式会话，并支持升级安全的输入恢复。

title.en: Desktop 1.38.11: Session reliability, Windows fixes, and image attachments
title.zh: 桌面版 1.38.11：会话可靠性、Windows 修复与图片附件

summary.en: This release improves session migration, takeover, and export reliability, fixes Windows credential and shell issues, and repairs image attachment handling across submission, history, and export.
summary.zh: 此版本提升了会话迁移、接管与导出的可靠性，修复了 Windows 凭据与 Shell 问题，并完善图片附件在提交、历史记录与导出中的处理。

title.zh: 历史会话按需迁移

body.en: Learn how historical sessions are migrated on demand and how to manage them.
body.zh: 了解历史会话如何按需迁移以及如何管理它们。

title.zh: 远程会话

body.en: Understand cross-client session takeover and remote session management.
body.zh: 了解跨端会话接管与远程会话管理。

title.zh: 会话草稿生命周期

body.en: Details on durable local drafts and their lifecycle.
body.zh: 关于持久化本地草稿及其生命周期的详细信息。

title.zh: 会话导出

body.en: How fixed-snapshot session exports work.
body.zh: 固定快照会话导出的工作原理。

title.zh: Windows 沙箱

body.en: Windows sandbox retirement and tool-layer boundaries.
body.zh: Windows 沙箱退役与工具层边界。

title.zh: 附件修复

body.en: Image attachment admission, persistence, and export.
body.zh: 图片附件的接纳、持久化与导出。

title.zh: 历史会话按需迁移

body.en: Startup no longer replays historical imports. Sessions appear in the sidebar and migrate when opened, with reliable identity and ownership.
body.zh: 启动时不再重放历史导入。会话显示在侧边栏中，打开时进行迁移，身份与所有权可靠。

title.zh: 跨端会话接管

body.en: Take over sessions between desktop and CLI with handoff, reclaim, and mirroring. CLI stays alive after desktop reclaims.
body.zh: 在桌面端与 CLI 之间通过交接、回收与镜像接管会话。桌面端回收后 CLI 保持存活。

title.zh: Windows 凭据自锁问题已解决

body.en: Credential saves no longer depend on ACL repair. The retired sandbox backend is removed, and credential files are protected from self-lockout.
body.zh: 凭据保存不再依赖 ACL 修复。已移除退役的沙箱后端，凭据文件受到保护，避免自锁。

title.zh: 会话中的图片附件

body.en: Images are admitted at the session boundary, persisted in drafts, shown in history, and included in exports.
body.zh: 图片在会话边界被接纳，持久化在草稿中，显示在历史记录中，并包含在导出中。

title.zh: 会话导出捕获完整历史

body.en: Exports now use a fixed authoritative snapshot, so long conversations include all messages and tool results.
body.zh: 导出现在使用固定的权威快照，因此长对话包含所有消息和工具结果。

title.zh: 授权确认不再卡死

body.en: Initial approvals and Stop actions work reliably, with proper cancellation and outcome propagation.
body.zh: 初始授权与停止操作可靠工作，具有正确的取消与结果传播。

title.zh: 持久化本地草稿

body.en: Drafts are saved per workspace without creating sessions, and legacy empty sessions are cleaned up.
body.zh: 草稿按工作区保存，无需创建会话，并清理历史空会话。

title.zh: 模型级思考能力

body.en: Reasoning settings are resolved per model, fixing legacy connections and session effort binding.
body.zh: 思考设置按模型解析，修复旧连接与会话思考强度的绑定。

title.zh: 会话标题一致性

body.en: AI renames now update all surfaces, and untitled sessions show their first user turn.
body.zh: AI 重命名现在更新所有界面，未命名会话显示其首条用户消息。

title.zh: 新会话草稿页

body.en: Healthy drafts show the welcome composer, and formal sessions are created only after first message.
body.zh: 健康草稿显示欢迎输入框，正式会话仅在首条消息后创建。

title.zh: 草稿模型与标题对齐

body.en: New-session drafts follow the live default model and avoid internal route titles.
body.zh: 新会话草稿遵循实时默认模型，避免内部路由标题。

title.zh: 会话状态归属

body.en: Interactive cards are bound to their originating request, preventing cross-session leaks.
body.zh: 交互卡片绑定到其原始请求，防止跨会话泄漏。

title.zh: Windows 工作区归属

body.en: Duplicate workspace owners are repaired, and navigation is cancellable during shutdown.
body.zh: 修复重复工作区所有者，导航在关闭期间可取消。

title.zh: 文件系统身份统一

body.en: Path identity and locks are unified across versions, fixing Windows casing issues.
body.zh: 路径身份与锁跨版本统一，修复 Windows 大小写问题。

title.zh: Windows Shell 执行

body.en: Shell commands use PowerShell with reliable working-directory and process handling.
body.zh: Shell 命令使用 PowerShell，工作目录与进程处理更加可靠。

title.zh: 会话导出身份

body.en: Exports are pinned to the captured session identity, preventing conflicts.
body.zh: 导出固定到捕获的会话身份，防止冲突。

title.zh: 归档会话保持归档

body.en: Single-head historical sessions no longer reappear after archiving.
body.zh: 单头历史会话归档后不再重新出现。

title.zh: 保存会话恢复

body.en: Startup reconciles saved tabs without losing valid sessions or unknown fields.
body.zh: 启动时协调保存的标签页，不丢失有效会话或未知字段。

title.zh: 快照记录身份

body.en: Every transcript record gets a stable identity, fixing hydration failures.
body.zh: 每条记录获得稳定身份，修复水合失败。

title.zh: 退出与诊断

body.en: Quit waits for session persistence, and crash diagnostics are improved.
body.zh: 退出等待会话持久化，崩溃诊断得到改进。

title.zh: AI 会话标题预算

body.en: The model round trip owns its full timeout, avoiding premature failures.
body.zh: 模型调用拥有完整超时，避免过早失败。

title.zh: 归档后空白会话

body.en: Archiving the last session no longer creates a blank replacement.
body.zh: 归档最后一个会话不再创建空白替代。

title.zh: Transcript 初始化崩溃

body.en: Malformed legacy baselines no longer crash startup; sessions remain repairable.
body.zh: 格式错误的旧基线不再导致启动崩溃；会话保持可修复。

title.zh: Session-id 路由隔离

body.en: Canonical session routes are separated from legacy file paths, preventing metadata corruption.
body.zh: 规范会话路由与旧文件路径分离，防止元数据损坏。

title.zh: Windows 凭据 ACL 测试

body.en: Test isolation prevents false failures in credential repair.
body.zh: 测试隔离防止凭据修复中的误报。

title.zh: ACP 销毁等待

body.en: Teardown tests are deterministic, avoiding timing flakiness.
body.zh: 销毁测试具有确定性，避免计时波动。

title.zh: 官网跟随当前正式版

body.en: The download pane now resolves the latest stable version instead of a stale pin.
body.zh: 下载面板现在解析最新正式版，而非过时的固定版本。

title.zh: Windows 沙箱已退役

body.en: The OS-level sandbox is no longer enforced. Shell commands run as the current user, with tool-layer boundaries still active.
body.zh: 操作系统级沙箱不再强制执行。Shell 命令以当前用户身份运行，工具层边界仍然有效。

title.en: Historical sessions migrate on first open
title.zh: 历史会话在首次打开时迁移

body.en: Startup is faster; historical sessions appear in the sidebar and migrate when you open them.
body.zh: 启动更快；历史会话显示在侧边栏中，打开时进行迁移。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.38.10

summary.en: This release focuses on session reliability, Windows upgrade and agent execution, file path handling, and transcript stability.
summary.zh: 此版本重点提升会话可靠性、Windows 升级与 Agent 执行、文件路径处理和对话记录稳定性。

title.zh: 应用会话所有权

body.en: Learn how sessions are owned and managed within the app.
body.zh: 了解会话在应用中的所有权和管理方式。

title.zh: 独立会话

body.en: Understand how independent sessions work and their lifecycle.
body.zh: 了解独立会话的工作原理及其生命周期。

title.zh: 管理页面

body.en: Explore management pages for sessions and archives.
body.zh: 探索会话和归档的管理页面。

title.zh: 对话记录架构

body.en: Details on the transcript architecture and its components.
body.zh: 对话记录架构及其组件的详细信息。

title.zh: Windows Agent Shell

body.en: Learn how persistent PowerShell preserves state and reports command completion on Windows.
body.zh: 了解持久 PowerShell 如何在 Windows 上保留状态并报告命令完成情况。

title.zh: Windows 安装程序验收

body.en: Acceptance criteria for Windows installer builds.
body.zh: Windows 安装程序构建的验收标准。

title.zh: 更可靠的会话管理

body.en: Sessions now keep their identity and history across restarts, with improved archive and trash handling.
body.zh: 会话现在在重启后保持身份和历史记录，归档和回收站处理得到改进。

title.zh: 更快的本地历史加载

body.en: Local session history appears immediately when switching tabs, without waiting for the runtime to start.
body.zh: 切换标签页时，本地会话历史立即显示，无需等待运行时启动。

title.zh: Windows 路径和升级修复

body.en: Fixed Windows file URIs, CLI diagnostics, legacy session upgrades, and installer identity issues.
body.zh: 修复了 Windows 文件 URI、CLI 诊断、旧会话升级和安装程序身份问题。

title.zh: 可展开会话与工作区上下文

body.en: Sidebar now shows 5 conversations per project or group, expandable in batches, with project and branch context for new sessions.
body.zh: 侧栏现在每个项目或分组显示 5 个会话，可分批展开，新会话支持项目和分支上下文。

title.zh: 重启后保留压缩上下文

body.en: Compacted model context now survives session switches, restarts, and legacy imports.
body.zh: 压缩后的模型上下文现在在切换会话、重启和导入旧会话后仍然保留。

title.zh: 修复用户消息历史分页

body.en: Sent messages no longer duplicate or disappear when history pages are reclaimed or confirmed outside the visible window.
body.zh: 发送的消息在历史页面回收或确认超出可见窗口时不再重复或消失。

title.zh: 统一模型凭据恢复

body.en: Desktop and CLI now share credential-slot, receipt, and recovery services, preventing missing credentials from reaching new turns.
body.zh: 桌面端与 CLI 现在共享凭据槽、回执和恢复服务，防止缺失凭据进入新对话轮次。

title.zh: 统一 Windows 桌面启动入口

body.en: Reasonix.exe is now the canonical Windows GUI entry, with legacy launcher compatibility preserved.
body.zh: Reasonix.exe 现在是 Windows 的规范 GUI 入口，同时保留旧启动器的兼容性。

title.zh: 后台对话通知

body.en: Background conversations now play attention sounds and show notifications without switching tabs.
body.zh: 后台对话现在无需切换标签页即可播放提示音并显示通知。

title.zh: 项目树展开与缓存逻辑

body.en: Project tree now uses a five-row initial window and five-row increments, with separate cache invalidation from visibility.
body.zh: 项目树现在使用五行初始窗口和五行增量，缓存失效与可见性分离。

title.en: Default session sorting to creation time
title.zh: 默认按创建时间排序

body.en: Existing workbench sort preferences reset to creation time once on first launch of this release.
body.zh: 此版本首次启动时，现有工作台排序偏好一次性重置为创建时间。

title.en: Reject Windows portable launches from remote storage
title.zh: 拦截 Windows 便携版共享目录启动

body.en: Windows portable launches from UNC and mapped remote drives are now rejected before Electron starts.
body.zh: 现在在 Electron 启动前拒绝从 UNC 和映射远程驱动器启动 Windows 便携版。

title.zh: 修复目录迁移的未读基线

body.en: Migrated history no longer shows blue attention dots due to placeholder read baselines.
body.zh: 迁移的历史记录不再因占位读取基线而显示蓝色未读点。

title.zh: 修复规范会话未读状态

body.en: Unread state now tracks only visible terminal assistant results, not metadata changes.
body.zh: 未读状态现在只跟踪可见的终端助手结果，而不是元数据更改。

title.en: Decouple durable local session operations from runtime tabs
title.zh: 本地会话持久化操作与运行时解耦

body.en: Session operations now resolve by explicit SessionRef, with improved title CAS and lifecycle guards.
body.zh: 会话操作现在通过显式 SessionRef 解析，改进了标题 CAS 和生命周期防护。

title.en: Repair official provider endpoint protocol conflicts
title.zh: 自动修复官方供应商协议与端点冲突

body.en: Conflicting official provider protocol/endpoint settings are now repaired automatically when the URL uniquely matches a catalog route.
body.zh: 当 URL 唯一匹配目录路由时，现在会自动修复冲突的官方供应商协议/端点设置。

title.en: Gate updater by stable build identity
title.zh: 按正式构建身份限制桌面更新器

body.en: Updater is now disabled in canary, preview, test, dev, and prerelease builds, with automatic checks throttled to once per six hours.
body.zh: 更新器现在在 canary、preview、test、dev 和 prerelease 构建中禁用，自动检查限制为每六小时一次。

title.en: Unify session archive, trash and historical recovery
title.zh: 统一会话归档、回收站与历史恢复

body.en: Archived sessions now use one durable lifecycle: normal session → Trash → restore or permanent deletion.
body.zh: 归档会话现在使用一个持久生命周期：正常会话 → 回收站 → 恢复或永久删除。

title.en: Restore legacy Desktop history without duplicate recovery copies
title.zh: 完善旧版对话迁移并排除重复恢复副本

body.en: Desktop upgrades now discover and consolidate legacy history across generations without duplicating recovery copies.
body.zh: 桌面升级现在跨代发现并整合旧版历史，不重复恢复副本。

title.en: Fix submission identity and persistent PowerShell
title.zh: 修复消息身份、工具状态与持久 PowerShell

body.en: Single sends no longer render twice, and Windows Agent execution uses persistent PowerShell with structured completion.
body.zh: 单次发送不再渲染两次，Windows Agent 执行使用带结构化完成的持久 PowerShell。

title.en: Move command palette search to sidebar footer
title.zh: 将命令面板搜索移至侧栏底部

body.en: Command palette search action moved from topic bar to the first sidebar footer slot.
body.zh: 命令面板搜索操作从主题栏移至侧栏底部的第一个插槽。

title.en: Collapse workspace dock when last tab closes
title.zh: 关闭最后一个标签页后自动收起工作区

body.en: Closing the last workspace tab now collapses the entire right dock and returns its space to the conversation.
body.zh: 关闭最后一个工作区标签页现在会收起整个右侧停靠栏，并将其空间返回给对话。

title.en: Fix AI session rename for canonical history
title.zh: 修复迁移后会话 AI 重命名失败

body.en: AI rename now reads authored turns from canonical durable history, fixing failures for migrated conversations.
body.zh: AI 重命名现在从规范持久历史中读取用户消息，修复了迁移对话的重命名失败。

title.en: Unify transcript recovery and completion with Follow v2
title.zh: 统一会话同步与完成机制

body.en: Completed, cancelled or reconnecting chats no longer lose visible text or show stale run state.
body.zh: 已完成、取消或重新连接的聊天不再丢失可见文本或显示过时的运行状态。

title.zh: 暂停与恢复改为追加式终结

body.en: Stopping a turn and opening another conversation no longer leaves durable history unreadable.
body.zh: 停止一个轮次并打开另一个对话不再导致持久历史不可读。

title.en: Restore ProjectTree and integrate session recovery fixes
title.zh: 恢复项目树并整合会话恢复修复

body.en: ProjectTree workbench sidebar restored, with session, history, chat-display, and terminal repairs integrated.
body.zh: 恢复了 ProjectTree 工作台侧栏，并整合了会话、历史、聊天显示和终端修复。

title.zh: 升级 Desktop SessionID 会话架构

body.en: Desktop canonical sessions now persist by SessionID only, preventing disappearance after switching or restart.
body.zh: 桌面规范会话现在仅按 SessionID 持久化，防止切换或重启后消失。

title.en: Keep migrated history stable through restart
title.zh: 保持迁移会话的身份并清除恢复后的错误提示

body.en: Startup and history continuation reuse the migrated session identity, preventing duplicate imports after metadata refresh. Successful history recovery also clears its error state without leaving a stale chat warning.
body.zh: 启动和继续读取历史时复用已迁移的会话身份，避免元数据刷新后重复导入。历史恢复成功后清除错误状态，不再残留错误的聊天警告。

title.zh: 稳定 Windows 发版验证

body.en: Fixed Windows validation defects including POSIX-only tests running on Windows and shell probe cache poisoning.
body.zh: 修复了 Windows 验证缺陷，包括在 Windows 上运行仅限 POSIX 的测试和 shell 探测缓存污染。

title.zh: 统一 PowerShell 冷启动握手预算

body.en: PowerShell now gets a 30-second budget from process start through connection acceptance and ready-frame receipt.
body.zh: PowerShell 现在从进程启动到连接接受和就绪帧接收有 30 秒预算。

title.en: Fix canonical history reuse across reopened tabs
title.zh: 修复重开会话的历史缓存复用

body.en: Canonical history windows now reuse warm residents when the same session reopens under a new tab ID.
body.zh: 规范历史窗口现在在同一会话以新标签 ID 重新打开时复用热驻留。

title.en: Serialize trash restore and permanent deletion
title.zh: 串行化回收站恢复与永久删除

body.en: Trash deletion now keeps the user's original confirmation snapshot through refresh, lock waits, retries, and restart.
body.zh: 回收站删除现在在刷新、锁等待、重试和重启期间保留用户的原始确认快照。

title.zh: 会话注册表升级

body.en: Existing sessions are migrated to the new registry format on first launch. Older clients cannot edit an upgraded v3 registry.
body.zh: 首次启动时，现有会话将迁移到新的注册表格式。旧客户端无法编辑升级后的 v3 注册表。

title.zh: Windows 安装程序身份

body.en: Installed test builds intentionally replace the same product and share data; portable builds keep program files separate.
body.zh: 安装的测试构建有意替换同一产品并共享数据；便携构建保持程序文件独立。

title.zh: 更新器限制

body.en: Updater is disabled in non-stable builds. Stable updates remain explicit: checks only read metadata, and download/install begins after user action.
body.zh: 非稳定构建中更新器已禁用。稳定更新保持显式：检查仅读取元数据，下载/安装需用户操作后开始。

title.zh: 降级需要新读取器

body.en: After pause/recovery changes, downgrading requires retaining the new reader or restoring a complete pre-upgrade backup.
body.zh: 暂停/恢复更改后，降级需要保留新读取器或恢复完整的升级前备份。

title.en: Reasonix v1.38.9: Session Reliability, Persistent Bash, and CDP Browser
title.zh: Reasonix v1.38.9：会话可靠性、持久化 Bash 与 CDP 浏览器

summary.en: This release focuses on session persistence and recovery, adds persistent bash sessions and a CDP browser backend, and improves file navigation and conversation navigation.
summary.zh: 本次发布聚焦会话持久化与恢复，新增持久化 bash 会话和 CDP 浏览器后端，并改进文件导航与对话导航。

title.zh: 桌面会话 v5

body.en: Learn about the new SessionID-only persistence architecture for desktop sessions.
body.zh: 了解桌面会话全新的仅 SessionID 持久化架构。

title.zh: CDP 浏览器后端

body.en: Documentation for the new CDP browser backend for CLI, Serve, and headless sessions.
body.zh: 面向 CLI、Serve 和无头会话的全新 CDP 浏览器后端文档。

title.zh: Dock 文件导航

body.en: Details on the command-driven file navigation ownership model.
body.zh: 命令驱动的文件导航所有权模型详情。

title.zh: 资源治理升级

body.en: How desktop session resources are bounded and managed.
body.zh: 桌面会话资源如何受限与管理。

title.zh: 对话大纲导航

body.en: Design and acceptance record for the complete turn navigator.
body.zh: 完整轮次导航器的设计与验收记录。

title.zh: 持久化轮次分叉报告

body.en: Report on forking completed turns from the persisted session log.
body.zh: 从持久化会话日志分叉已完成轮次的报告。

title.zh: 会话快速恢复

body.en: How fast recovery and independent history work.
body.zh: 快速恢复与独立历史的工作原理。

title.zh: 仅 SessionID 的桌面持久化

body.en: Desktop sessions now use a single SessionID-based persistence architecture, preventing session loss and improving reliability after restarts.
body.zh: 桌面会话现采用基于单一 SessionID 的持久化架构，防止会话丢失并提升重启后的可靠性。

title.zh: 持久化 bash 会话

body.en: Foreground bash calls now share a session-level PTY, so cd, exported variables, and shell functions persist across calls.
body.zh: 前台 bash 调用现共享会话级 PTY，因此 cd、导出变量和 shell 函数可在多次调用间保持。

title.zh: CDP 浏览器后端

body.en: CLI, Serve, and headless sessions can now use the same browser tools as the Electron shell through the new CDP backend.
body.zh: CLI、Serve 和无头会话现可通过新的 CDP 后端使用与 Electron 外壳相同的浏览器工具。

title.zh: 完整轮次导航器

body.en: The turn navigator now indexes every turn of the conversation, not just loaded ones, with absolute ordinals and previews.
body.zh: 轮次导航器现在索引对话中的每个轮次，而不仅是已加载的轮次，并带有绝对序号和预览。

title.zh: 命令驱动的 Dock 文件导航

body.en: Opening a file is now a command owned by the running instance, eliminating render loops and stale navigation races.
body.zh: 打开文件现在是由运行实例持有的命令，消除了渲染循环和过时的导航竞态。

title.en: Session History Recovery on Model Startup Failure
title.zh: 模型启动失败时恢复会话历史

body.en: Durable session history remains visible even when a saved model connection no longer exists and controller startup fails.
body.zh: 即使保存的模型连接不再存在且控制器启动失败，持久会话历史仍保持可见。

title.zh: 恢复 CLI YOLO 权限快捷键

body.en: Ctrl+Y toggles YOLO mode with the canonical danger-full-access preset, and Shift+Tab cycles through all four permission states.
body.zh: Ctrl+Y 使用规范的 danger-full-access 预设切换 YOLO 模式，Shift+Tab 循环切换全部四种权限状态。

title.zh: 仅 SessionID 的桌面持久化

body.en: Desktop sessions now use a single SessionID-based persistence architecture, preventing session loss and improving reliability after restarts.
body.zh: 桌面会话现采用基于单一 SessionID 的持久化架构，防止会话丢失并提升重启后的可靠性。

title.zh: 持久化 bash 会话

body.en: Foreground bash calls now share a session-level PTY, so cd, exported variables, and shell functions persist across calls.
body.zh: 前台 bash 调用现共享会话级 PTY，因此 cd、导出变量和 shell 函数可在多次调用间保持。

title.zh: CDP 浏览器后端

body.en: CLI, Serve, and headless sessions can now use the same browser tools as the Electron shell through the new CDP backend.
body.zh: CLI、Serve 和无头会话现可通过新的 CDP 后端使用与 Electron 外壳相同的浏览器工具。

title.zh: 完整轮次导航器

body.en: The turn navigator now indexes every turn of the conversation, not just loaded ones, with absolute ordinals and previews.
body.zh: 轮次导航器现在索引对话中的每个轮次，而不仅是已加载的轮次，并带有绝对序号和预览。

title.zh: 命令驱动的 Dock 文件导航

body.en: Opening a file is now a command owned by the running instance, eliminating render loops and stale navigation races.
body.zh: 打开文件现在是由运行实例持有的命令，消除了渲染循环和过时的导航竞态。

title.en: Resolve and Preview Files Named in Chat Answers
title.zh: 识别并预览回答中提到的文件

body.en: Files mentioned in chat answers are now resolved and previewable, including SVG code blocks rendered as images.
body.zh: 回答中提到的文件现在可以被识别和预览，包括以图片形式渲染的 SVG 代码块。

title.en: Fork Completed Turns from Persisted Session Log
title.zh: 从持久化会话日志分叉已结束轮次

body.en: Forking a completed turn now uses an immutable anchor, enabling the branch button even while a newer turn runs.
body.zh: 分叉已结束轮次现在使用不可变锚点，即使有更新的轮次正在运行，分支按钮也可用。

title.zh: 限制桌面会话资源占用

body.en: Transcript residency and expensive resources are now bounded with explicit budgets and ownership.
body.zh: 转录驻留和昂贵资源现在通过明确的预算和所有权进行限制。

title.zh: 修复锚定弹层生命周期

body.en: Portaled overlays like the model selector now close correctly when their trigger becomes invalid.
body.zh: 模型选择器等传送门弹层现在在其触发器失效时正确关闭。

title.zh: 恢复 CLI YOLO 权限快捷键

body.en: Ctrl+Y toggles YOLO mode with the canonical danger-full-access preset, and Shift+Tab cycles through all four permission states.
body.zh: Ctrl+Y 使用规范的 danger-full-access 预设切换 YOLO 模式，Shift+Tab 循环切换全部四种权限状态。

title.en: Session History Recovery on Model Startup Failure
title.zh: 模型启动失败时恢复会话历史

body.en: Durable session history remains visible even when a saved model connection no longer exists and controller startup fails.
body.zh: 即使保存的模型连接不再存在且控制器启动失败，持久会话历史仍保持可见。

title.en: Close Desktop Session Services Before Store Root Removal
title.zh: 在删除会话存储根目录前先关闭会话服务

body.en: Fixed a Windows-only test failure where session services held recovery database handles during cleanup.
body.zh: 修复了仅 Windows 上会话服务在清理期间持有恢复数据库句柄的测试失败。

title.zh: 释放冷启动阶段的会话写者租约

body.en: Fixed a Windows-only leak where the cold-open session writer lease was not released, causing test failures.
body.zh: 修复了仅 Windows 上冷启动会话写者租约未释放导致的测试失败。

title.zh: 修复 Windows 测试任务

body.en: Fixed multiple root causes behind the Windows CI test job failures, including writer leases and watcher helper entry.
body.zh: 修复了 Windows CI 测试任务失败的多个根本原因，包括写者租约和监听 helper 入口。

title.zh: 修复编辑块文件系统竞态

body.en: Closed exists→write and read→write races in edit-blocks with a single fd-scoped flow.
body.zh: 通过单一 fd 作用域流程关闭了编辑块中的存在→写入和读取→写入竞态。

title.en: Probe Every Approved Manual Desktop Tag
title.zh: 探测全部已授权手动下载标签

body.en: The download page now probes every approved manual tag, preventing downgrades when a newer tag is not yet published.
body.zh: 下载页面现在探测所有已授权的手动标签，防止在较新标签尚未发布时降级。

title.en: Manual download required for this desktop release
title.zh: 本次桌面版需要手动下载安装

body.en: Code signing is temporarily unavailable, so this desktop release is published for manual download on every platform and automatic updates stay on the previous version.
