Windows packages carry no Reasonix Authenticode signature and may show an unknown-publisher warning; detached minisign signatures and SHA-256 checksums are still published for every artifact. CLI and npm distribution are unaffected.
body.zh: 由于代码签名服务暂不可用，本次桌面版所有平台均以手动下载方式发布，自动更新保留在上一版本。Windows 安装包不含 Reasonix Authenticode 签名，系统可能提示未知发布者；每个产物仍提供 minisign 签名和 SHA-256 校验值。CLI 和 npm 发布不受影响。

title.zh: 桌面会话 v5 与降级说明

body.en: Desktop sessions move to SessionID-only storage. The migrator reads existing v4 and legacy history without modifying it, so downgrading keeps your earlier sessions, but sessions created only under v5 are not visible to older releases. Protocol 9 is a hard desktop shell/host boundary; update the desktop app and CLI together.
body.zh: 桌面会话改为仅按 SessionID 存储。迁移器只读取而不修改既有 v4 与旧版历史，因此降级后原有会话仍在；但仅在 v5 下新建的会话，旧版本无法看到。Protocol 9 是桌面外壳与宿主的硬边界，请同步更新桌面端与 CLI。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.38.8

summary.en: Desktop reliability and usability improvements, including unified session persistence, Goal lifecycle fixes, and installer updates.
summary.zh: 桌面端可靠性与易用性改进，包括统一会话持久化、目标生命周期修复和安装程序更新。

title.zh: 会话存储 v4

body.en: Learn about the new session storage format and migration.
body.zh: 了解新的会话存储格式和迁移。

title.zh: 会话 v4 实现报告

body.en: Detailed implementation report for session v4.
body.zh: 会话 v4 的详细实现报告。

title.en: Unified session persistence with bounded large-history recovery
title.zh: 统一会话持久化并支持大会话恢复

body.en: Sessions now use a canonical storage service with a new v4 format, enabling large history recovery without the previous 128 MiB replay ceiling.
body.zh: 会话现在使用规范存储服务和新的 v4 格式，支持大会话恢复，不再受之前 128 MiB 重放上限限制。

title.en: Goal lifecycle recovery and host controls
title.zh: 修复目标生命周期恢复与宿主控制

body.en: Recovered Goals retain their objectives across continuation rounds, while stale actions are rejected to preserve user pauses.
body.zh: 恢复后的目标会在续跑轮次中保留原有任务内容，并拒绝过期操作以保留用户暂停状态。

title.zh: 优化桌面端模型与工作区导航

body.en: The model picker now offers provider filters, favorites, and catalog-wide search, and the workspace dock opens Overview when empty.
body.zh: 模型选择器现在提供提供商筛选、收藏和全目录搜索，工作区停靠栏为空时自动打开概览。

title.en: Desktop updates and slimmer native packages
title.zh: 修复桌面更新并精简原生安装包

body.en: macOS updates now resolve the app bundle correctly, and native packages are significantly smaller.
body.zh: macOS 更新现在能正确解析应用包，原生安装包体积显著减小。

title.zh: 统一会话持久化

body.en: Sessions now use a canonical storage service with a new v4 format, enabling large history recovery without the previous 128 MiB replay ceiling.
body.zh: 会话现在使用规范存储服务和新的 v4 格式，支持大会话恢复，不再受之前 128 MiB 重放上限限制。

title.zh: 模型选择器重新设计

body.en: The model picker now offers provider filters, favorites, and catalog-wide search.
body.zh: 模型选择器现在提供提供商筛选、收藏和全目录搜索。

title.zh: 简化文件编辑与错误恢复

body.en: File edits check the version observed by a read, while ordinary tool errors no longer block unrelated work behind proof or recovery-confirmation gates. Permission policy, sandboxing and Plan approval remain enforced. Unknown external effects are recorded without automatically replaying them.
body.zh: 文件编辑会核对读取时观察到的版本；普通工具错误不再通过证据或恢复确认门禁阻塞后续工作。权限策略、沙箱和计划批准仍然生效。结果未知的外部操作会保留记录，不会自动重放。

title.zh: 目标生命周期对齐

body.en: Goal state changes now reject stale actions, helping preserve user pauses and prevent overlapping continuation rounds.
body.zh: 目标状态变更现在会拒绝过期操作，保留用户暂停状态，并防止多个续跑轮次重叠。

title.zh: 慢启动时显示启动提示

body.en: Fast launches open directly; slower launches show a lightweight startup hint.
body.zh: 快速启动直接打开应用；较慢的启动会显示轻量级启动提示。

title.zh: 修复会话关闭与 Windows 恢复

body.en: Session shutdown no longer races background state reads. Windows path case changes reuse the same session writer, and failed session switches release their previous file handles.
body.zh: 修复会话关闭与后台状态读取之间的数据竞争。Windows 路径大小写变化会复用同一个会话写入器，会话切换失败后也会正确释放此前的文件句柄。

title.zh: 修复便携包首次启动

body.en: The first-run migrator now finds the CLI under its portable-package filename.
body.zh: 首次启动迁移程序现在能按便携包内的正确文件名找到 CLI。

title.zh: 目标生命周期恢复

body.en: Recovered Goals retain their objectives across continuation rounds, while stale actions are rejected to preserve user pauses.
body.zh: 恢复后的目标会在续跑轮次中保留原有任务内容，并拒绝过期操作以保留用户暂停状态。

title.zh: 桌面更新和更小的安装包

body.en: macOS updates now resolve the app bundle correctly, and native packages are significantly smaller.
body.zh: macOS 更新现在能正确解析应用包，原生安装包体积显著减小。

title.zh: 安装程序重试扫描器锁定的文件

body.en: Windows installer now retries transient file locks and offers a Retry option.
body.zh: Windows 安装程序现在会重试瞬态文件锁，并提供重试选项。

title.zh: 直接启动可找到服务

body.en: Launching Reasonix.exe directly now correctly locates the desktop service.
body.zh: 直接启动 Reasonix.exe 现在能正确定位桌面服务。

title.zh: Linux 包权限

body.en: Linux packages now let normal users read and enter the application directory.
body.zh: 修复 Linux 安装包的应用目录权限，普通用户可以正常读取并进入该目录。

title.zh: 修复对话区拖动问题

body.en: Transcript no-drag no longer punches through the Electron titlebar.
body.zh: 对话区 no-drag 不再穿透 Electron 标题栏。

title.en: Tool changes may reset the prompt cache once
title.zh: 工具变更可能使提示缓存首次失效

body.en: Retired proof tools and updated tool schemas change the request prefix after upgrading. A one-time cache miss is expected; subsequent turns retain stable tool ordering and prefixes.
body.zh: 旧证据工具的移除和工具描述变更会改变升级后的请求前缀，首次请求可能无法复用原有缓存；后续轮次保持稳定的工具顺序和前缀。

title.zh: 会话迁移与降级说明

body.en: Existing sessions migrate into a separate v4 directory when continued; their original files remain unchanged. Older versions cannot read new v4 history, so update Desktop and CLI together. Browsing or migrating a session does not automatically resume its Goal or restore approvals.
body.zh: 继续旧会话时会迁移到独立的 v4 目录，原始文件保持不变。旧版本无法读取新增的 v4 历史，请同步更新桌面端和 CLI。浏览或迁移会话不会自动续跑目标，也不会恢复执行批准。

title.en: Manual update required for pre-1.38.4 clients
title.zh: 1.38.4 之前的客户端需要手动更新

body.en: Desktops on v1.38.3 or older cannot update in-app and must install the full package manually.
body.zh: v1.38.3 或更早版本的桌面端无法在应用内更新，必须手动安装完整包。

title.en: First index build for very large sessions
title.zh: 超大会话首次建立索引需要时间

body.en: The reference 1 GiB history test took about 115 seconds to build its first index. Index construction is cancellable; this measurement is not a session size limit.
body.zh: 参考测试中，1 GiB 历史的首次索引构建耗时约 115 秒。构建可以取消，该测量值不代表会话容量上限。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.38.7

summary.en: Desktop reliability and usability improvements, including Windows startup fixes, browser controls, and transcript layout corrections.
summary.zh: 桌面端可靠性与易用性改进，包括 Windows 启动修复、浏览器控制以及聊天记录布局修正。

title.zh: Windows 应用身份

body.en: How Reasonix desktop isolates its Windows taskbar identity from Studio and manages shortcuts.
body.zh: Reasonix 桌面端如何隔离其 Windows 任务栏身份与 Studio，并管理快捷方式。

title.zh: Windows 启动恢复

body.en: Design and acceptance criteria for recovering from a failed desktop shell on Windows.
body.zh: Windows 上从失效桌面壳恢复的设计与验收标准。

title.zh: 桌面浏览器

body.en: Built-in browser control settings and Chrome sign-in state import.
body.zh: 内置浏览器控制设置与 Chrome 登录状态导入。

title.zh: 聊天记录投影

body.en: Unified projection of history snapshots and live events for transcripts.
body.zh: 聊天记录的历史快照与实时事件统一投影。

title.zh: 检查点

body.en: Configurable rewind snapshot retention policy.
body.zh: 可配置的回溯快照保留策略。

title.zh: 内置浏览器控制设置

body.en: A new Browser control page in Settings lets you enable the built-in browser, import Chrome sign-in state, manage certificate verification, and clear browser data.
body.zh: 设置中心新增“浏览器控制”页面，可启用内置浏览器、导入 Chrome 登录状态、管理证书验证并清除浏览器数据。

title.zh: Windows 启动与窗口可靠性

body.en: Fixes for failed shell recovery, taskbar identity isolation, startup console flash, and window geometry persistence.
body.zh: 修复失效壳恢复、任务栏身份隔离、启动黑框闪现以及窗口几何信息持久化问题。

title.zh: 聊天记录布局与命令可见性

body.en: Long content no longer overflows the chat pane, and expanded terminal tool cards show the complete command.
body.zh: 长内容不再溢出聊天面板，展开的终端工具卡显示完整命令。

title.zh: 内置浏览器控制设置

body.en: Added a Browser control page in Settings Centre with controls for enabling the built-in browser, importing Chrome sign-in state, ignoring certificate errors for guest sessions, and clearing browser cache or all data.
body.zh: 设置中心新增“浏览器控制”页面，可启用内置浏览器、导入 Chrome 登录状态、忽略访客会话证书错误，以及清除浏览器缓存或全部数据。

title.zh: 可配置的检查点保留策略

body.en: Added [checkpoints] configuration with retain_turns and blob_quota_bytes to control rewind snapshot retention.
body.zh: 新增 [checkpoints] 配置项 retain_turns 与 blob_quota_bytes，用于控制回溯快照保留。

title.zh: 聊天记录投影统一

body.en: Unified history snapshot and live event projection to prevent duplicate content and skipped events, with improved checkpoint performance.
body.zh: 统一历史快照与实时事件投影，避免内容重复与事件遗漏，并提升检查点性能。

title.zh: 会话切换校验

body.en: Session-switch snapshots are now validated against the controller's captured history, and load phases are reported.
body.zh: 会话切换快照现会与控制器捕获的历史进行校验，并报告加载阶段。

title.zh: 限时性能采样

body.en: Performance diagnostics now use bounded sampling and on-demand profiling to identify stalls and memory growth without continuous CPU profiling.
body.zh: 性能诊断现采用限时采样与按需分析，无需持续 CPU 采样即可识别卡顿与内存增长。

title.zh: 能力阶段指标修复

body.en: Fixed capability_phases duration buckets that were always zero by emitting and billing all phases.
body.zh: 修复 capability_phases 耗时桶恒为零的问题，补齐阶段发出与计费。

title.zh: Windows 壳生命周期恢复

body.en: Fixed stale shell processes holding the single-instance lock after a failed service handshake, with explicit recovery state model.
body.zh: 修复服务握手失败后失效壳进程占用单实例锁的问题，引入显式恢复状态模型。

title.zh: Windows 任务栏身份隔离

body.en: Desktop now uses io.reasonix.desktop for shell, launcher, service, shortcuts, and notifications to avoid grouping with Studio.
body.zh: 桌面端现使用 io.reasonix.desktop 作为壳、启动器、服务、快捷方式与通知的身份，避免与 Studio 归组。

title.zh: Windows 启动黑框闪现

body.en: Prevented a console window from briefly appearing when launching the Windows desktop from its shortcut.
body.zh: 修复从快捷方式启动 Windows 桌面时短暂出现控制台窗口的问题。

title.zh: 窗口几何信息持久化

body.en: Persist the restore rectangle instead of the maximized frame to avoid oversized windows on restore.
body.zh: 持久化还原矩形而非最大化边框，避免还原时出现超大窗口。

title.zh: 聊天记录溢出与命令可见性

body.en: Long content no longer expands the transcript beyond the chat pane, and expanded shell cards show the complete command.
body.zh: 长内容不再使聊天记录超出聊天面板，展开的终端工具卡显示完整命令。

title.zh: 压缩回执可见性

body.en: The /compact receipt now renders outside the process fold so users can see compaction results.
body.zh: /compact 回执现渲染在进程折叠之外，用户可看到压缩结果。

title.zh: WSL 剪贴板 UTF-8 保留

body.en: Fixed garbled text when copying Chinese or other UTF-8 content from WSL by using a PowerShell UTF-8 bridge instead of raw clip.exe.
body.zh: 修复从 WSL 复制中文等 UTF-8 内容出现乱码的问题，改用 PowerShell UTF-8 桥接而非原始 clip.exe。

title.zh: 模型覆盖 max_output_tokens 保留

body.en: Fixed per-model max_output_tokens being silently dropped when used alone.
body.zh: 修复单独使用逐模型 max_output_tokens 时被静默丢弃的问题。

title.zh: DeepSeek Flash 思考深度

body.en: Fixed missing reasoning depth control for deepseek-flash alias.
body.zh: 修复 deepseek-flash 别名缺少思考深度控制的问题。

title.en: First upgrade from v1.38.3 or earlier requires the full package
title.zh: 从 v1.38.3 或更早版本首次升级需手动安装完整包

body.en: Desktops on v1.38.3 or an older Wails release cannot update in-app across the Electron shell change: their updater stops with "unsupported install_layout electron-v1 (keeping current version)" and leaves the installation untouched. Quit Reasonix and install the full Windows installer, macOS DMG, or Linux .deb/tar.gz from the download page. Configuration, sessions and history are kept.
body.zh: v1.38.3 或更早 Wails 版本的桌面端无法通过应用内更新跨越 Electron 壳切换：更新器会提示“unsupported install_layout electron-v1 (keeping current version)”并保持现有安装不变。请退出 Reasonix，从下载页安装完整的 Windows 安装程序、macOS DMG 或 Linux .deb/tar.gz。配置、会话与历史记录原样保留。

title.zh: 修复桌面端无法启动

summary.en: Fixes a build mismatch that prevented official Desktop packages from starting.
summary.zh: 修复了导致官方桌面安装包无法启动的构建不匹配问题。

title.zh: 官方桌面安装包可正常启动

body.en: Fixes the build_mismatch error that prevented v1.38.5 from opening after a fresh install or upgrade. The desktop shell and bundled service now use the same release identity.
body.zh: 修复 v1.38.5 在全新安装或升级后出现 build_mismatch、无法打开的问题。桌面壳与内置服务现在使用一致的发布版本信息。

title.zh: 发布前验证正式包启动

body.en: Windows, macOS, and Linux release checks now launch the packaged app in production mode and require a successful service handshake, a renderer-to-service call, and clean shutdown. Missing or invalid build metadata remains an error.
body.zh: Windows、macOS 和 Linux 发布检查现在以正式模式启动打包应用，要求服务握手、界面到服务的实际调用及正常退出全部成功。构建信息缺失或无效时仍会报错。

title.en: Install the full package to recover startup
title.zh: 安装完整包恢复启动

body.en: If v1.38.5 cannot open, download and install the v1.38.6 full package. Do not clear your configuration or session data. Users moving from v1.38.3 or an older Wails release must also install the full package manually for the first Electron upgrade; the old updater cannot install the new layout.
body.zh: 如果 v1.38.5 无法打开，请下载并安装 v1.38.6 完整包，无需清理配置或会话数据。从 v1.38.3 或更早 Wails 版本首次升级到 Electron 时，也需要手动安装完整包；旧版更新器无法安装新的目录结构。

title.en: OpenCode Go Responses search limitation remains
title.zh: OpenCode Go Responses 搜索限制仍然存在

body.en: This startup hotfix does not change the previously reported OpenCode Go Responses native-search limitation. Use the Anthropic search route verified for v1.38.5 when web search is needed.
body.zh: 本次启动修复未改变此前已报告的 OpenCode Go Responses 原生搜索限制。需要联网搜索时，请使用 v1.38.5 已验证的 Anthropic 搜索路径。

title.zh: Reasonix v1.38.5

summary.en: Reasonix moves Desktop to Electron and adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash image input, OpenCode Go provider presets, durable tool recovery, and independent dock tabs. This release includes the changes since v1.38.3, macOS signing and notarization fixes, and more reliable Windows extension shutdown; v1.38.4 was not published.
summary.zh: Reasonix 桌面端迁移至 Electron，新增 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 图片输入、OpenCode Go 提供商预设、持久工具恢复和独立 dock 标签。本版本包含 v1.38.3 以来的改动、macOS 签名与公证修复，以及 Windows 扩展关闭稳定性修复；v1.38.4 未公开发布。

title.zh: 工具恢复

body.en: Learn how to recover interrupted tool executions in desktop and remote sessions.
body.zh: 了解如何在桌面和远程会话中恢复中断的工具执行。

title.zh: 读取证据生命周期

body.en: Understand how read coverage and write guards are decoupled to avoid repeated work.
body.zh: 了解读取覆盖与写入守卫如何解耦，以避免重复工作。

title.zh: 输入区控件

body.en: Details on live composer readings and turn metric accuracy improvements.
body.zh: 关于输入区实时读数和回合指标准确性改进的详细信息。

title.zh: Electron 桌面壳

body.en: Desktop now runs on Electron in place of Wails, with shell-owned window lifecycle, zoom, and browser panels.
body.zh: 桌面端改用 Electron 替代 Wails，由桌面壳管理窗口生命周期、缩放和浏览器面板。

title.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash native image input
title.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 原生图片输入

body.en: The official DeepSeek provider now supports V4.1 Flash native image input and the 2026-09-10 price schedule. The model list correctly reports image capability, and cost quotes use the new prices.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek 提供商现支持 V4.1 Flash 原生图片输入及 2026-09-10 价格表。模型列表正确报告图片能力，成本报价使用新价格。

title.zh: 持久工具恢复

body.en: Interrupted tool executions can now be recovered in desktop and remote sessions through evidence-backed actions, including inspection, confirmation, rejection, and optional safe retry.
body.zh: 中断的工具执行现在可以在桌面和远程会话中通过证据支持的操作进行恢复，包括检查、确认、拒绝和可选的安全重试。

title.en: Workspace-isolated launcher with independent view tabs
title.zh: 工作区隔离启动器与独立视图标签

body.en: The right dock now supports repeatable view tabs for Files, Changes, Context, and host panels, each restoring its own state, with a full-width title bar.
body.zh: 右侧 dock 现支持文件、改动、上下文和宿主面板的可重复视图标签，每个视图独立恢复状态，并采用全宽标题栏。

title.en: Fixed legacy remote Serve send failures
title.zh: 修复旧版远程 Serve 发送失败

body.en: Remote sessions connecting to older Serve versions no longer fail; the status probe now correctly handles HTML index responses.
body.zh: 远程会话连接旧版 Serve 时不再失败；状态探测现在能正确处理 HTML 索引响应。

title.zh: 证据门禁不再重复工作

body.en: Operations are now host-owned, preventing the agent from repeating work due to evidence or verification mismatches.
body.zh: 操作现在由宿主拥有，防止代理因证据或验证不匹配而重复工作。

title.en: Accurate turn metrics and live composer readings
title.zh: 准确的回合指标与输入区实时读数

body.en: Turn metric readings now come from a single source, token estimates are more accurate for Han characters, and live readings appear in the composer run strip.
body.zh: 回合指标读数现在来自单一来源，对汉字字符的令牌估算更准确，并在输入区运行条中显示实时读数。

title.zh: 硬件加速设置

body.en: A new persistent Electron hardware acceleration setting with recovery overrides for blank screens and rendering failures.
body.zh: 新增持久化的 Electron 硬件加速设置，并提供针对黑屏和渲染故障的恢复覆盖。

title.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 支持

body.en: Official DeepSeek provider now supports V4.1 Flash native image input and the 2026-09-10 price schedule.
body.zh: 官方 DeepSeek 提供商现支持 V4.1 Flash 原生图片输入及 2026-09-10 价格表。

title.zh: 持久工具恢复

body.en: Interrupted tool executions can be recovered in desktop and remote sessions with evidence-backed actions.
body.zh: 中断的工具执行可以在桌面和远程会话中通过证据支持的操作进行恢复。

title.en: Workspace-isolated launcher with independent view tabs
title.zh: 工作区隔离启动器与独立视图标签

body.en: Right dock supports repeatable view tabs for Files, Changes, Context, and host panels with independent state restoration.
body.zh: 右侧 dock 支持文件、改动、上下文和宿主面板的可重复视图标签，每个视图独立恢复状态。

title.zh: 硬件加速设置

body.en: Persistent Electron hardware acceleration setting with recovery overrides.
body.zh: 持久化的 Electron 硬件加速设置，并提供恢复覆盖。

title.zh: Electron 桌面壳

body.en: Desktop now runs on Electron in place of Wails, with shell-owned window lifecycle, zoom, and browser panels.
body.zh: 桌面端改用 Electron 替代 Wails，由桌面壳管理窗口生命周期、缩放和浏览器面板。

title.zh: OpenCode Go 提供商预设

body.en: The OpenCode Go curated provider preset is available, with its routing, reasoning, and search contracts carried onto the current kernel.
body.zh: 新增 OpenCode Go curated 提供商预设，其路由、推理与搜索契约已迁移到当前内核。

title.en: Turn metric accuracy and live composer readings
title.zh: 回合指标准确性与输入区实时读数

body.en: Turn metrics now use a single definition, better Han character token estimates, and live readings in the composer run strip.
body.zh: 回合指标现在使用单一来源，汉字令牌估算更准确，并在输入区运行条中显示实时读数。

title.en: Electron zoom ownership and legacy migration
title.zh: Electron 缩放归属与旧配置迁移

body.en: App zoom uses a versioned Electron store and imports explicitly user-selected legacy zoom once.
body.zh: 应用缩放使用版本化的 Electron 存储，并一次性导入旧版中由用户明确设置的缩放比例。

title.zh: 外部链接协议限制

body.en: Only http, https, and mailto protocols are allowed for external links.
body.zh: 外部链接仅允许 http、https 和 mailto 协议。

title.zh: Windows 扩展关闭稳定性

body.en: Forced extension shutdown and normal process cleanup now release the Windows process-tracking handle exactly once, preventing later cleanup from closing an unrelated reused handle.
body.zh: 强制关闭扩展与正常进程回收现在只释放一次 Windows 进程跟踪句柄，避免后续清理误关已被其他对象复用的句柄。

title.zh: 旧版远程 Serve 发送失败

body.en: Remote sessions connecting to older Serve versions no longer fail; status probe handles HTML index responses.
body.zh: 远程会话连接旧版 Serve 时不再失败；状态探测能正确处理 HTML 索引响应。

title.zh: 证据门禁不再重复工作

body.en: Operations are host-owned, preventing repeated work due to evidence or verification mismatches.
body.zh: 操作由宿主拥有，防止因证据或验证不匹配而重复工作。

title.zh: macOS 应用签名顺序

body.en: Signs the adjacent Go service before sealing the main executable and outer app bundle, fixing the observed notarization failure.
body.zh: 在主程序与外层应用包完成签名前，先签名相邻的 Go 服务，修复本次发现的公证失败。

title.zh: 完整的 Electron macOS 包签名

body.en: Signs all nested code objects in the Electron bundle, including Go sidecars and frameworks, to pass notarization.
body.zh: 对 Electron 包中的所有嵌套代码对象（包括 Go 侧车和框架）进行签名，以通过公证。

title.en: Decouple read coverage and write guards
title.zh: 解耦读取覆盖与写入守卫

body.en: Partial file reads no longer freeze independent tools and final answers.
body.zh: 部分文件读取不再冻结独立工具和最终答案。

title.zh: 恢复 104px 输入框默认高度

body.en: Fresh profiles now use the compact 104px composer height again.
body.zh: 新配置文件现在再次使用紧凑的 104px 输入框高度。

title.zh: 修复运行中输入控件可用性

body.en: Running local desktop tasks can now add attachments and references through existing composer controls.
body.zh: 运行中的本地桌面任务现在可以通过现有输入控件添加附件和引用。

title.en: Cancel status refresh during catalog shutdown
title.zh: 修复 catalog 关闭时状态刷新超时

body.en: Catalog shutdown cancels in-flight status refreshes so they do not outlive the catalog worker.
body.zh: 历史目录关闭时会取消进行中的状态刷新，避免刷新工作超过目录工作线程的生命周期。

title.zh: 降级前先完成中断工具恢复

body.en: Inspect and confirm unresolved tool effects before downgrading the owning runtime. Older executables do not enforce the new recovery guarantees; new recovery metadata remains additive and safe retry is disabled by default.
body.zh: 降级运行时前，请先检查并确认未决的工具执行结果。旧版程序不会执行新增的恢复保护；恢复元数据以增量方式保存，安全重试默认关闭。

title.zh: OpenCode Go Responses 搜索限制

body.en: Release checks could not obtain completed native search evidence from the OpenCode Go DeepSeek Responses route. Use the verified OpenCode Go Anthropic search route for web search. Ordinary model calls, tool replay, and image input passed; the Responses search path is not claimed as verified for this release.
body.zh: 发布实测未能从 OpenCode Go DeepSeek Responses 路径取得已完成的原生搜索证据。联网搜索请使用已验证的 OpenCode Go Anthropic 路径。普通模型调用、工具回放和图片输入已通过；本版本不将 Responses 搜索标记为已验证。

summary.en: This release brings DeepSeek V4.1 Flash support with native image input and updated pricing, durable tool recovery across desktop and remote sessions, a scoped dock launcher with independent view tabs, and numerous fixes for remote sends, evidence handling, and desktop stability.
summary.zh: 此版本带来 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 支持（原生图片输入与更新定价）、桌面与远程会话的持久工具恢复、带独立视图标签的工作区隔离启动器，以及针对远程发送、证据处理和桌面稳定性的多项修复。

title.zh: 能力诊断

body.en: Learn about skill tool reference diagnostics.
body.zh: 了解技能工具引用诊断。

title.en: Save model settings without an active session
title.zh: 无需活动会话即可保存模型设置

body.en: Save model preferences and provider connections even before a session starts. The default model applies to new sessions; existing sessions retain their selection. Accepted work keeps its original connection through tools, retries, approvals and children, while affected settings apply before the next run.
body.zh: 会话尚未启动时也能保存模型偏好和供应商连接。默认模型用于新会话，已有会话保留自己的选择。已经开始的任务及其工具、重试、审批和子任务继续使用原连接，相关设置在下一次运行前生效。

title.en: Keep local and remote activity indicators in sync
title.zh: 同步本地与远程任务状态

body.en: Fix activity indicators that kept spinning after completion. Local Desktop and remote Serve sessions share committed runtime state, resynchronize after reconnect, and retain known content while a connection is uncertain. Follow-up messages remain queued while a turn finishes.
body.zh: 修复任务结束后仍持续转圈的问题。本地桌面与远程 Serve 会话使用一致的运行状态，重连后重新同步；连接状态不确定时保留已知内容。任务收尾期间发送的后续消息会保留在队列中。

title.en: Inspect the changes and checks from each turn
title.zh: 查看每轮实际改动与检查结果

body.en: Turn results show confirmed net file changes and recorded commands, exit codes and logs. Open the frozen diff for that turn without mixing in later edits. Missing or partial evidence is labelled explicitly and is never presented as a successful check.
body.zh: 本轮结果展示确认的净文件改动，以及实际执行的命令、退出码和日志。可以查看该轮固定的差异，不混入后续编辑；缺失或不完整的证据会明确标注，不会被显示为检查通过。

title.zh: 工作台欢迎页与会话恢复

body.en: Empty Workbench sessions center the welcome and composer, then return to the conversation layout after the first message. Persistent retry controls expose history-load or remote-connection failures while preserving existing messages and drafts.
body.zh: 空工作台会话居中展示欢迎内容和输入栏，发送首条消息后回到对话布局。历史加载或远程连接失败时持续显示重试入口，并保留已有消息和草稿。

title.en: Clearer composer controls and running feedback
title.zh: 更清晰的输入栏操作与运行反馈

body.en: Plan, goal and delivery options move into the add menu with removable mode chips. Model and reasoning controls are separate, menus adapt to narrow windows, and a theme-aware border animation shows running activity. Runtime metrics remain available in the context popover.
body.zh: 计划、目标和交付选项移入添加菜单，启用后可通过模式标签移除。模型与思考强度分开选择，菜单适配窄窗口；输入栏边框动画显示运行状态，耗时等指标可在上下文浮层中查看。

title.en: Finish inbox scans before retiring a session runtime
title.zh: 会话运行时退出前完成收件箱扫描

body.en: Closing or replacing a session runtime waits for its autonomous inbox scan to finish. Model refresh can still retire its own runtime safely before the next queued request starts.
body.zh: 关闭或替换会话运行时时，会先等待自动收件箱扫描结束。模型刷新仍可在下一条排队请求启动前安全替换当前运行时。

title.en: Reliable file-read progress and pause reporting
title.zh: 准确记录文件读取进度与暂停原因

body.en: A large-file preview no longer creates an unintended obligation to read the entire file. Completed reads remain complete after output deduplication, edits still require current source evidence, and an incomplete-read pause stays visible alongside the model reply in live and restored history.
body.zh: 大文件预览不再意外触发全文读取要求；已完成的读取不会因输出去重重新变为未完成，编辑仍须满足当前文件版本的读取条件。读取未完成导致暂停时，实时与恢复后的历史都会在模型回复旁显示暂停原因。

title.zh: 一致的技能工具诊断

body.en: Remove false use_capability warnings from built-in review skills. Both doctor entrypoints recognize the same effective tools and plugin-scoped MCP aliases while retaining warnings for unknown names and malformed references. Static diagnosis does not start MCP servers.
body.zh: 消除内置评审技能的 use_capability 误报。两个 doctor 入口识别一致的实际工具和插件范围内的 MCP 别名，同时保留未知名称及格式错误提示。静态诊断不会启动 MCP 服务。

title.en: Keep settings search and save actions visible
title.zh: 避免设置搜索框和保存操作被遮挡

body.en: Keep the search field outside the scrolling settings navigation. Hooks and Network save actions no longer cover the editor or proxy inputs, and their buttons wrap on narrow windows.
body.zh: 设置搜索框与滚动导航分离。Hooks 和网络设置的保存操作不再覆盖编辑器或代理输入框，窄窗口下按钮可自动换行。

title.en: More reliable Windows sessions and update recovery
title.zh: 提升 Windows 会话与更新恢复可靠性

body.en: Use consistent identities for detached-session status. Concurrent legacy-update recovery and task snapshot saves tolerate brief Windows readers without losing transaction checks or exposing a partially written snapshot.
body.zh: 分离会话状态使用一致的会话标识。旧版更新的并发恢复和任务快照保存能够处理 Windows 短暂文件占用，同时保留事务校验，避免暴露部分写入的快照。

title.en: Let MCP processes finish graceful shutdown
title.zh: 让 MCP 进程正常完成关闭

body.en: Close MCP transports before cancelling their process context. On Windows, release the process job before making its instance slot available, improving reconnect and shutdown reliability.
body.zh: 先关闭 MCP 传输，再取消进程上下文。Windows 上在释放实例名额前清理进程作业，提升重连与关闭的可靠性。

title.en: Preserve connection labels and prompt-history identity
title.zh: 保留正确的连接显示与提示词历史标识

body.en: Restored sessions show the selected connection without opening the model menu. Display-only metadata reads no longer replace process credentials, and separate prompt-history directories cannot share a cache identity merely because they were opened within one clock tick.
body.zh: 恢复会话后，无需打开模型菜单即可显示选中的连接。仅用于显示的元数据读取不再改写进程凭据；不同提示词历史目录也不会因在同一时钟刻度打开而误用缓存。

title.zh: 升级由 Desktop 管理的旧版 Serve

body.en: Saved configuration and history remain readable without manual migration. For Desktop-managed remote sessions, an older Serve without settings-snapshot support must be upgraded or safely reconnected after its current work finishes. Saving a setting does not forcibly stop that work.
body.zh: 保存的配置与历史无需手动迁移。对于由 Desktop 管理的远程会话，不支持设置快照的旧版 Serve 需要在当前任务结束后升级或安全重连；保存设置不会强制终止当前任务。

title.en: Status bar initially uses icon labels
title.zh: 状态栏首次采用图标样式

body.en: New and existing configurations initially adopt icon labels. You can select text labels in settings; choices made after this migration are preserved.
body.zh: 新配置和已有配置首次采用图标标签。可在设置中切换回文字样式，此次迁移后的手动选择会被保留。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.38.2

summary.en: This release improves session reliability, model service configuration, and desktop performance. It introduces append-only session logs with version heads, independent web search model assignment, unified image understanding, and fixes for navigation, cancellation, and CI stability.
summary.zh: 此版本提升了会话可靠性、模型服务配置和桌面性能。引入了仅追加会话日志与版本 head、独立网页搜索模型分配、统一图片理解，并修复了导航、取消和 CI 稳定性等多项问题。

title.en: Append-only session logs with version heads
title.zh: 仅追加会话日志与版本 head

body.en: Sessions now use an append-only DAG log (schema 2), recording every change as a version head. Forking, rewinding, and version selection happen within the same log instead of creating separate files, improving reliability and supporting concurrent writers.
body.zh: 会话现在使用仅追加 DAG 日志（schema 2），将每次更改记录为版本 head。分叉、回退和版本选择均在同一日志内完成，不再创建单独文件，提高了可靠性并支持并发写入。

title.zh: 会话渲染器替换

body.en: The transcript now runs on the full DOM/windowed renderer with one scroll writer and one input-intent owner, replacing Virtuoso. Tail-follow intent and measured-height publication survive native scrolling, so visible content is no longer squeezed during fast scrolls.
body.zh: 会话记录改用 Full DOM/窗口化渲染器，由单一滚动写入者与输入意图所有者驱动，替代 Virtuoso。原生滚动中的尾部跟随意图与实测高度发布得以保留，快速滚动时可见内容不再被挤压。

title.zh: 独立网页搜索模型

body.en: You can now specify a dedicated connection and model for web search queries in Model preferences. Automatic remains the default and preserves existing selection behavior.
body.zh: 现在可以在模型偏好中为网页搜索查询指定专用连接和模型。自动模式仍为默认，并保留现有选择行为。

title.en: Unified local and tool image understanding
title.zh: 统一本地图片与工具图片识别

body.en: Add view_image(path) and share the existing image-summary service between user attachments and all successful structured tool-image results, including MCP and on-demand MCP tools.
body.zh: 新增 view_image(path)，并在用户附件与所有成功的结构化工具图片结果（包括 MCP 和按需 MCP 工具）之间共享现有图片摘要服务。

title.zh: 修复模型服务入口跳错页面

body.en: Clicking Model services no longer opens Model preferences. The navigation store now preserves the requested page and remembered settings target.
body.zh: 点击“模型服务”不再进入“模型偏好”。导航 store 现在保留请求的页面和记忆的设置目标。

title.en: Stop is now a session-level interrupt
title.zh: 停止按钮改为会话级无条件中断

body.en: Stop now interrupts whatever is running in the session, even if the turn ID is stale. Only an idle tab is rejected with a stable error code.
body.zh: 停止现在会中断会话中正在运行的内容，即使回合 ID 已过期。只有空闲标签页才会以稳定错误代码被拒绝。

title.en: Provider recovery waiting is bounded and surfaced
title.zh: 供应商恢复等待加上限并醒目提示

body.en: A turn on a flaky network or overloaded provider no longer waits indefinitely. After a total waiting budget of 10 minutes, the turn ends with a clear, actionable error.
body.zh: 在网络不稳定或供应商过载时，回合不再无限等待。总等待预算为 10 分钟后，回合会以清晰、可操作的错误结束。

title.zh: 并行工具取消有界化

body.en: A tool that ignores cancellation no longer wedges the whole turn. After a bounded grace period, the turn abandons the straggler and reports an explicit interrupted result.
body.zh: 忽略取消的工具不再使整个回合卡住。在有界的宽限期后，回合会放弃掉队者并报告明确的已中断结果。

title.en: Sessions stay listed after a crash
title.zh: 崩溃后会话不再从侧栏消失

body.en: After a hard kill mid-turn, conversations no longer disappear from the sidebar. Last-known preview and turn count are kept as display hints while repair runs.
body.zh: 在回合中途强制终止后，会话不再从侧栏消失。在修复运行时，保留最后已知的预览和回合计数作为显示提示。

title.en: Rejected backend calls no longer crash the UI
title.zh: 后端调用失败改为提示而非崩溃遮罩

body.en: Errors from backend calls in the recovery-lineage dialog are now contained as toasts instead of replacing the window with a crash overlay.
body.zh: 恢复谱系对话框中后端调用的错误现在以提示形式呈现，而不是用崩溃遮罩替换窗口。

title.en: Compaction un-stuck on thinking-model summaries and unnumbered overflows
title.zh: 修复思考型模型摘要与无数字超窗导致的分段压缩死锁

body.en: Compaction no longer fails on thinking-model summaries that put the briefing in reasoning_content, and provider overflows without token numbers now trigger the chunked fallback.
body.zh: 压缩不再因思考型模型将摘要放在 reasoning_content 中而失败，且无 token 数字的供应商超窗现在会触发分段回退。

title.en: Summary-request overflow self-recovers and rescues over-ceiling context
title.zh: 摘要请求超窗自恢复与硬上限截断救援

body.en: When a summary request overflows, the system now recalibrates, re-plans a smaller prefix, and falls back to transcript form or truncation rescue instead of retrying the identical request.
body.zh: 当摘要请求超窗时，系统现在会重新校准、重新规划更小的前缀，并回退到转录形式或截断救援，而不是重试相同的请求。

title.zh: 统一设置选择组件与模型偏好布局

body.en: Settings pages now use shared compact SettingsSelect and SettingsOptions components, providing consistent sizing, focus states, and keyboard behavior. Model preferences are grouped with vertically stacked runtime preferences.
body.zh: 设置页面现在使用共享的紧凑 SettingsSelect 和 SettingsOptions 组件，提供一致的尺寸、焦点状态和键盘行为。模型偏好与垂直堆叠的运行时偏好分组。

title.zh: 系统修复模型连接协议与错误恢复

body.en: Changing a saved provider connection's API format no longer creates invalid routes. Protocol conflicts are rejected with a recommended endpoint, and provider failures reload as their original error.
body.zh: 更改已保存的供应商连接的 API 格式不再产生无效路由。协议冲突会以推荐端点被拒绝，供应商失败会以其原始错误重新加载。

title.en: Model settings preserved and DeepSeek protocol migrated
title.zh: 完善模型配置与 DeepSeek 协议迁移

body.en: Custom model IDs are now preserved exactly, and existing official DeepSeek connections are migrated to Chat Completions as the default protocol.
body.zh: 自定义模型 ID 现在被精确保留，现有的官方 DeepSeek 连接迁移到 Chat Completions 作为默认协议。

title.en: Desktop checks shortened and signed release artifacts reused
title.zh: 缩短桌面检查并复用已签名发版产物

body.en: Desktop PR checks now share frontend build artifacts and run tests concurrently, and stable releases reuse the signed artifacts from preflight.
body.zh: 桌面 PR 检查现在共享前端构建产物并并发运行测试，稳定版发布复用预检的已签名产物。

title.en: Memory screen baseline settled before judging drift
title.zh: 内存筛查先稳定基线再判定漂移

body.en: The app-memory screen now settles the baseline before comparing counters, preventing false drift reports from a noisy first sample.
body.zh: 应用内存筛查现在在比较计数器之前稳定基线，防止因嘈杂的第一个样本而产生错误的漂移报告。

title.zh: 修复设置组件布局所有权

body.en: The model assignment matrix in Settings no longer wraps the connection label below the purpose. Shared layout defaults have lower specificity so component layouts retain ownership.
body.zh: 设置中的模型分配矩阵不再将连接标签换行到用途下方。共享布局默认值具有较低的特异性，因此组件布局保留所有权。

title.zh: 修复上下文准备入口的取消语义

body.en: A context preparation request cancelled before admission no longer returns success through a fast path. Cancellation is checked before and after acquiring the maintenance lock.
body.zh: 在准入前取消的上下文准备请求不再通过快速路径返回成功。在获取维护锁之前和之后都会检查取消。

title.zh: 为 Windows WebView2 选择测试加上限，避免阻塞 CI 队列

body.en: The desktop-windows job now has a job-level timeout and the native selection smoke kills the whole process tree on timeout, preventing CI queue blockage.
body.zh: desktop-windows 作业现在有作业级超时，原生选择测试在超时时会终止整个进程树，防止 CI 队列阻塞。

title.en: Race-suite tests deterministic and test job bounded
title.zh: 让两个 race 测试确定化并为 test job 加上限

body.en: Two timing-sensitive race tests are now deterministic, and the test job has a job-level timeout to prevent wedged Windows steps from holding the CI concurrency group.
body.zh: 两个对时序敏感的 race 测试现在具有确定性，test 作业有作业级超时，防止卡住的 Windows 步骤占用 CI 并发组。

title.zh: Standard / Deep 会话展示设置

body.en: A single session-experience setting controls how much completed work stays visible: Standard collapses finished work, Deep keeps it expanded. The backend owns persistence and startup snapshots.
body.zh: 新增统一的会话展示设置：Standard 折叠已完成内容，Deep 保持展开；持久化与启动快照由后端权威管理。

title.en: Independent model connections and model preferences
title.zh: 独立模型连接与模型偏好

body.en: Model services are independent connections with stable identities, display names and separate credentials. Adding a connection selects a brand, product and protocol, and first-run setup opens this flow.
body.zh: 模型服务成为具有稳定标识、显示名称与独立凭据的独立连接；新增连接时选择品牌、产品与协议，首次启动设置即进入该流程。

title.en: Append-only session logs with version heads
title.zh: 仅追加会话日志与版本 head

body.en: Sessions now use an append-only DAG log (schema 2), recording every change as a version head. Forking, rewinding, and version selection happen within the same log instead of creating separate files, improving reliability and supporting concurrent writers.
body.zh: 会话现在使用仅追加 DAG 日志（schema 2），将每次更改记录为版本 head。分叉、回退和版本选择均在同一日志内完成，不再创建单独文件，提高了可靠性并支持并发写入。

title.zh: 独立网页搜索模型

body.en: You can now specify a dedicated connection and model for web search queries in Model preferences. Automatic remains the default and preserves existing selection behavior.
body.zh: 现在可以在模型偏好中为网页搜索查询指定专用连接和模型。自动模式仍为默认，并保留现有选择行为。

title.en: Unified local and tool image understanding
title.zh: 统一本地图片与工具图片识别

body.en: Add view_image(path) and share the existing image-summary service between user attachments and all successful structured tool-image results, including MCP and on-demand MCP tools.
body.zh: 新增 view_image(path)，并在用户附件与所有成功的结构化工具图片结果（包括 MCP 和按需 MCP 工具）之间共享现有图片摘要服务。

title.zh: 供应商恢复等待加上限并醒目提示

body.en: A turn on a flaky network or overloaded provider no longer waits indefinitely. After a total waiting budget of 10 minutes, the turn ends with a clear, actionable error.
body.zh: 在网络不稳定或供应商过载时，回合不再无限等待。总等待预算为 10 分钟后，回合会以清晰、可操作的错误结束。

title.zh: 并行工具取消有界化

body.en: A tool that ignores cancellation no longer wedges the whole turn. After a bounded grace period, the turn abandons the straggler and reports an explicit interrupted result.
body.zh: 忽略取消的工具不再使整个回合卡住。在有界的宽限期后，回合会放弃掉队者并报告明确的已中断结果。

title.en: Sessions stay listed after a crash
title.zh: 崩溃后会话不再从侧栏消失

body.en: After a hard kill mid-turn, conversations no longer disappear from the sidebar. Last-known preview and turn count are kept as display hints while repair runs.
body.zh: 在回合中途强制终止后，会话不再从侧栏消失。在修复运行时，保留最后已知的预览和回合计数作为显示提示。

title.en: Rejected backend calls no longer crash the UI
title.zh: 后端调用失败改为提示而非崩溃遮罩

body.en: Errors from backend calls in the recovery-lineage dialog are now contained as toasts instead of replacing the window with a crash overlay.
body.zh: 恢复谱系对话框中后端调用的错误现在以提示形式呈现，而不是用崩溃遮罩替换窗口。

title.en: Compaction un-stuck on thinking-model summaries and unnumbered overflows
title.zh: 修复思考型模型摘要与无数字超窗导致的分段压缩死锁

body.en: Compaction no longer fails on thinking-model summaries that put the briefing in reasoning_content, and provider overflows without token numbers now trigger the chunked fallback.
body.zh: 压缩不再因思考型模型将摘要放在 reasoning_content 中而失败，且无 token 数字的供应商超窗现在会触发分段回退。

title.en: Summary-request overflow self-recovers and rescues over-ceiling context
title.zh: 摘要请求超窗自恢复与硬上限截断救援

body.en: When a summary request overflows, the system now recalibrates, re-plans a smaller prefix, and falls back to transcript form or truncation rescue instead of retrying the identical request.
body.zh: 当摘要请求超窗时，系统现在会重新校准、重新规划更小的前缀，并回退到转录形式或截断救援，而不是重试相同的请求。

title.en: Memory screen baseline settled before judging drift
title.zh: 内存筛查先稳定基线再判定漂移

body.en: The app-memory screen now settles the baseline before comparing counters, preventing false drift reports from a noisy first sample.
body.zh: 应用内存筛查现在在比较计数器之前稳定基线，防止因嘈杂的第一个样本而产生错误的漂移报告。

title.zh: 修复设置组件布局所有权

body.en: The model assignment matrix in Settings no longer wraps the connection label below the purpose. Shared layout defaults have lower specificity so component layouts retain ownership.
body.zh: 设置中的模型分配矩阵不再将连接标签换行到用途下方。共享布局默认值具有较低的特异性，因此组件布局保留所有权。

title.zh: 修复上下文准备入口的取消语义

body.en: A context preparation request cancelled before admission no longer returns success through a fast path. Cancellation is checked before and after acquiring the maintenance lock.
body.zh: 在准入前取消的上下文准备请求不再通过快速路径返回成功。在获取维护锁之前和之后都会检查取消。

title.zh: 为 Windows WebView2 选择测试加上限，避免阻塞 CI 队列

body.en: The desktop-windows job now has a job-level timeout and the native selection smoke kills the whole process tree on timeout, preventing CI queue blockage.
body.zh: desktop-windows 作业现在有作业级超时，原生选择测试在超时时会终止整个进程树，防止 CI 队列阻塞。

title.en: Race-suite tests deterministic and test job bounded
title.zh: 让两个 race 测试确定化并为 test job 加上限

body.en: Two timing-sensitive race tests are now deterministic, and the test job has a job-level timeout to prevent wedged Windows steps from holding the CI concurrency group.
body.zh: 两个对时序敏感的 race 测试现在具有确定性，test 作业有作业级超时，防止卡住的 Windows 步骤占用 CI 并发组。

title.zh: 桌面稳定性与恢复修复

summary.en: This release restores prompt answers and recovery flows, fences stale desktop session state, unifies Ask and decision popups, and fixes DeepSeek weekend pricing.
summary.zh: 此版本恢复了提问提交与恢复流程，隔离了过期的桌面会话状态，统一了 Ask 与决策弹窗，并修复了 DeepSeek 周末计费。

title.zh: 桌面提示身份

body.en: How desktop prompt cards are identified and fenced across turns, runtimes, and reconnects.
body.zh: 桌面提示卡片如何跨轮次、运行时和重连进行标识与隔离。

title.zh: 会话恢复与并行

body.en: Unified session recovery and parallel-work lifecycle contracts for the Go rewrite.
body.zh: Go 重写中统一的会话恢复与并行工作生命周期契约。

title.zh: 工具契约

body.en: Bilingual guidance for tool argument validation, capability recovery, soft convergence, compatibility, and cache impact.
body.zh: 关于工具参数验证、能力恢复、软收敛、兼容性和缓存影响的双语指南。

title.zh: 恢复提问提交与状态恢复

body.en: Exact Ask answers no longer fail as not pending, and unwritable event ledgers no longer deadlock cancellation or prompt resolution. Keyboard-entered custom answers are preserved, Ask drafts are isolated by tab/runtime/turn/prompt identity, and background recovery errors are contained.
body.zh: 精确的 Ask 回答不再因未挂起而失败，不可写的事件账本不再导致取消或提示解析死锁。键盘输入的自定义答案得以保留，Ask 草稿按标签页/运行时/轮次/提示身份隔离，后台恢复错误得到遏制。

title.zh: 隔离过期提示卡片

body.en: Delayed Ask or decision-card responses can no longer outlive the turn or controller that created them. Each prompt is bound to a promptId, turnId, runtimeEpoch, and kind, and stale responses expire only the matching identity.
body.zh: 延迟的 Ask 或决策卡片响应不再能超过创建它们的轮次或控制器。每个提示都绑定到 promptId、turnId、runtimeEpoch 和 kind，过期响应仅使匹配的身份失效。

title.zh: 修复桌面会话状态竞态

body.en: Sessions no longer appear empty or unable to execute while their transcript or runtime is still present. Late events from a previous session binding are rejected using runtimeEpoch and sessionGeneration fences.
body.zh: 会话不再在转录或运行时仍存在时显示为空或无法执行。来自先前会话绑定的延迟事件通过 runtimeEpoch 和 sessionGeneration 隔离被拒绝。

title.zh: 统一 Ask 与决策弹窗

body.en: The desktop Ask surface now matches DeepSeek Harness with compact header controls, per-question pager, inline custom answers, draft restoration, and a shared visual shell for approvals, MCP interactions, runtime decisions, and extension forms.
body.zh: 桌面 Ask 界面现在与 DeepSeek Harness 一致，具有紧凑的标题控件、逐题分页器、内联自定义答案、草稿恢复，以及用于审批、MCP 交互、运行时决策和扩展表单的共享视觉外壳。

title.zh: 修复 Ask 自定义回答草稿丢失

body.en: Selecting a suggested option no longer clears a custom answer draft. The draft is preserved per question and restored when reopening custom input.
body.zh: 选择建议选项不再清除自定义答案草稿。草稿按问题保留，并在重新打开自定义输入时恢复。

title.zh: 修复主题栏打开器 key 冲突

body.en: Switching projects no longer leaves duplicate external-opener controls in the topic bar. Component keys are namespaced independently to prevent stale instances.
body.zh: 切换项目不再在主题栏中留下重复的外部打开器控件。组件键独立命名空间化，以防止陈旧实例。

title.zh: 修复 DeepSeek 周末峰值计费

body.en: DeepSeek peak pricing is no longer applied on Saturdays and Sundays. The pricing schedule now correctly applies only Monday through Friday.
body.zh: DeepSeek 峰值计费不再在周六和周日应用。计费表现在正确地仅适用于周一至周五。

title.zh: 可恢复的工具参数错误

body.en: Malformed tool arguments are now reported as actionable unexecuted errors instead of escalating into a blocked permission-style state. A redundant top-level arguments wrapper is detected conservatively, and repairable use_capability envelope errors are diagnosed without masking authorization failures.
body.zh: 格式错误的工具参数现在报告为可操作的未执行错误，而不是升级为阻塞的权限样式状态。保守地检测冗余的顶层 arguments 包装器，并在不掩盖授权失败的情况下诊断可修复的 use_capability 信封错误。

title.zh: 统一并行与会话恢复契约

body.en: Recovery copies now have explicit version identity and state. Recovery failures are persisted as pending with localized retry guidance, and worktree lifecycle payloads identify source revision and owning task/conversation.
body.zh: 恢复副本现在具有明确的版本身份和状态。恢复失败以挂起状态持久化，并提供本地化的重试指导，工作树生命周期负载标识源修订和所属任务/会话。

body.zh: 桌面 Ask 界面现在与 DeepSeek Harness 一致，具有紧凑的标题控件、逐题分页器、内联自定义答案、草稿恢复，以及用于审批、MCP 交互、运行时决策和扩展表单的共享视觉外壳。

title.en: Reasonix 1.38: Independent search, resilient recovery, and a unified desktop workspace
title.zh: Reasonix 1.38：独立搜索、可靠恢复与统一桌面工作区

summary.en: This release separates web search from the main conversation, hardens protocol recovery, and unifies desktop management pages. It also improves link menus, update relaunch stability, model image capability handling, and session actions.
summary.zh: 此版本将网络搜索与主对话分离，增强协议恢复可靠性，并统一桌面管理页面。同时改进了链接菜单、更新重启稳定性、模型图像能力处理以及会话操作。

title.zh: 管理页面

body.en: Learn how to use the unified management pages for settings, trash, and automation.
body.zh: 了解如何使用统一的设置、回收站和自动化管理页面。

title.zh: 模型能力

body.en: Understand how model capabilities are discovered and overridden.
body.zh: 了解模型能力的发现与覆盖方式。

title.zh: 模型设置

body.en: Configure provider and model settings with the new editor.
body.zh: 使用新编辑器配置提供程序和模型设置。

title.zh: 网络搜索

body.en: Details on the independent web search feature.
body.zh: 独立网络搜索功能的详细信息。

title.zh: 独立网络搜索

body.en: Web search now runs separately from the main conversation, with its own recovery budget and clear reporting when structured sources are missing.
body.zh: 网络搜索现在独立于主对话运行，拥有自己的恢复预算，并在缺少结构化来源时提供清晰报告。

title.zh: 可靠的协议恢复

body.en: Eligible protocol failures now offer a one-time recovery from valid history through the Desktop button, CLI /recover-context, Serve, and ACP. Recovery survives restart and respects cancellation.
body.zh: 可恢复的协议错误现在支持通过桌面按钮、CLI /recover-context、Serve 和 ACP 从有效历史恢复一次，重启后保留恢复状态，并遵守取消操作。

title.zh: 统一管理页面

body.en: Settings, Trash, and Automation now use full-window management pages with shared navigation and focus isolation, while keeping the workspace mounted.
body.zh: 设置、回收站和自动化现在使用全窗口管理页面，具有共享导航和焦点隔离，同时保持工作区挂载。

title.zh: 无障碍富链接菜单

body.en: Web, GitHub, and mail links now have context menus with open/copy actions and compact GitHub references, with full keyboard support.
body.zh: 网络、GitHub 和邮件链接现在具有上下文菜单，提供打开/复制操作和紧凑的 GitHub 引用，并支持完整的键盘操作。

title.zh: 稳定的更新重启

body.en: Versioned updates now relaunch through the permanent launcher, and the update banner refreshes hourly and on focus without interrupting active operations.
body.zh: 版本化更新现在通过永久启动器重启，更新横幅每小时及获得焦点时刷新，不会中断正在进行的操作。

title.zh: 模型图像能力覆盖

body.en: Provider models with unknown image capability can now be manually enabled or disabled, with official protocol restrictions taking precedence.
body.zh: 图像能力未知的提供程序模型现在可以手动启用或禁用，官方协议限制优先。

title.zh: 富链接上下文菜单

body.en: Added context menus for web, GitHub, and mail links with open, copy, and compact reference actions.
body.zh: 为网络、GitHub 和邮件链接添加了上下文菜单，包含打开、复制和紧凑引用操作。

title.zh: 统一管理页面

body.en: Settings, Trash, and Automation now use full-window management pages with shared navigation and focus isolation.
body.zh: 设置、回收站和自动化现在使用全窗口管理页面，具有共享导航和焦点隔离。

title.zh: 独立网络搜索

body.en: Web search is decoupled from the main conversation with its own recovery budget and reporting.
body.zh: 网络搜索与主对话解耦，拥有自己的恢复预算和报告。

title.zh: 协议恢复加固

body.en: Eligible protocol failures now offer a one-time recovery from valid history through the Desktop button, CLI /recover-context, Serve, and ACP. Recovery survives restart and respects cancellation.
body.zh: 可恢复的协议错误现在支持通过桌面按钮、CLI /recover-context、Serve 和 ACP 从有效历史恢复一次，重启后保留恢复状态，并遵守取消操作。

title.zh: 模型图像能力覆盖

body.en: Added per-model Auto/On/Off image input control and improved capability discovery for relays.
body.zh: 添加了每个模型的自动/开/关图像输入控制，并改进了中转站的能力发现。

title.zh: 恢复会话操作

body.en: Copy, export, terminal, and summary actions are now directly available in the topic bar.
body.zh: 复制、导出、终端和摘要操作现在可直接在主题栏中使用。

title.zh: 更新重启稳定性

body.en: Relaunch now uses the permanent launcher, and tray identity and recovery are more reliable.
body.zh: 重启现在使用永久启动器，托盘身份和恢复更加可靠。

title.zh: 自动化控件重叠

body.en: Fixed overlapping controls when opening Automation tasks, including Windows caption buttons and macOS workspace toggle.
body.zh: 修复了打开自动化任务时控件重叠的问题，包括 Windows 标题按钮和 macOS 工作区切换。

title.zh: macOS 工作区对齐

body.en: Workspace tabs now share the title row with the toggle, preventing overlap at minimum dock width.
body.zh: 工作区选项卡现在与切换按钮共享标题行，防止在最小停靠宽度下重叠。

title.zh: DeepSeek 主对话默认协议

body.en: Built-in DeepSeek conversations use Chat Completions again while web search runs independently through the official search endpoint. The one-time configuration upgrade preserves model, effort, search preferences and explicit custom routes.
body.zh: 内置 DeepSeek 主对话恢复使用 Chat Completions，网络搜索独立使用官方搜索端点。一次性配置升级保留模型、思考等级、搜索偏好和显式自定义路由。

title.zh: 恢复与降级边界

body.en: A model may request a completed read-only tool again after protocol repair. Verified file-write recovery prevents repeated satisfied writes, but this is not a guarantee for arbitrary shell or MCP effects. Older clients can read ordinary history but cannot enforce the new recovery accounting; do not use a downgrade to resume an unresolved protocol incident.
body.zh: 协议修复后，模型可能再次请求已经完成的只读工具。已验证的文件写入恢复可避免重复执行已满足的写入，但不能据此保证任意 shell 或 MCP 副作用不重复。旧客户端可读取普通历史，但无法执行新的恢复约束；请勿通过降级续跑尚未解决的协议故障。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.37.0

summary.en: This release simplifies the agent core, improves provider capability handling, stabilizes desktop scrolling, and adds ModelScope as a provider preset.
summary.zh: 此版本简化了 Agent 核心，改进了提供商能力处理，稳定了桌面滚动，并新增 ModelScope 提供商预设。

title.zh: Agent 核心简化

body.en: Learn about the simplified agent loop, explicit planner and continuation policies, and the new deterministic completion flow.
body.zh: 了解简化的 Agent 循环、显式的 planner 和 continuation 策略，以及新的确定性完成流程。

title.zh: 模型能力

body.en: Details on model-level vision capabilities and the new capability metadata contract.
body.zh: 关于模型级视觉能力和新能力元数据契约的详细信息。

title.zh: 推理提供商

body.en: Updated reasoning replay and recovery behavior for OpenAI-compatible providers.
body.zh: 针对 OpenAI 兼容提供商的推理回放和恢复行为更新。

title.en: Simplified agent core with deterministic completion
title.zh: 简化 Agent 核心并采用确定性完成流程

body.en: The agent loop is now executor-only by default, with explicit opt-in for planner, continuation, and compaction. Completion no longer uses a second LLM validator; empty responses retry the same frozen request.
body.zh: Agent 循环现在默认仅执行器，planner、continuation 和 compaction 需显式启用。完成不再使用第二个 LLM 验证器；空响应会重试相同的冻结请求。

title.zh: 模型级视觉能力

body.en: Vision support is now determined by model-level capability metadata instead of manual VisionModels lists, with automatic parsing from provider /models responses.
body.zh: 视觉支持现在由模型级能力元数据决定，而非手动 VisionModels 列表，并自动从提供商 /models 响应解析。

title.zh: ModelScope 提供商预设

body.en: Added ModelScope as an OpenAI-compatible provider preset with 7 curated models, including Qwen3.5-397B and DeepSeek-V4.
body.zh: 新增 ModelScope 作为 OpenAI 兼容提供商预设，包含 7 个精选模型，如 Qwen3.5-397B 和 DeepSeek-V4。

title.zh: 稳定的会话滚动

body.en: Fixed multiple scroll jump issues, including reduced-motion compounding, block-window prepends, and late range commits.
body.zh: 修复了多个滚动跳动问题，包括减少动画叠加、块窗口前插和延迟范围提交。

title.en: Management commands no longer require a turn ID
title.zh: 管理命令不再需要回合 ID

body.en: Slash commands like /compact and /context now complete without creating an agent turn, avoiding spurious errors.
body.zh: /compact 和 /context 等斜杠命令现在无需创建 Agent 回合即可完成，避免虚假错误。

title.zh: ModelScope 提供商预设

body.en: Added ModelScope as an OpenAI-compatible provider preset with 7 curated models.
body.zh: 新增 ModelScope 作为 OpenAI 兼容提供商预设，包含 7 个精选模型。

title.zh: 模型级视觉能力

body.en: Replaced manual VisionModels with model-level capability metadata, including automatic parsing from provider /models responses.
body.zh: 用模型级能力元数据取代手动 VisionModels，包括自动从提供商 /models 响应解析。

title.zh: 确定性 Agent 完成

body.en: Removed the completion validator second-LLM request; empty responses retry the same frozen request, and reasoning-only responses may finish without visible text.
body.zh: 移除了完成验证器的第二次 LLM 请求；空响应重试相同的冻结请求，仅推理的响应可能在没有可见文本的情况下完成。

title.zh: 显式 planner 和 continuation

body.en: Ordinary requests are executor-only; planner and continuation are opt-in. Pressure compaction is one summary plus one retry.
body.zh: 普通请求仅执行器；planner 和 continuation 需显式启用。压力压缩为一次摘要加一次重试。

title.zh: OpenAI 推理回放对齐

body.en: Replay historical reasoning_content turns when tools are declared, and self-heal stale-history 400 errors.
body.zh: 当声明工具时回放历史 reasoning_content 回合，并自愈旧历史 400 错误。

title.zh: 子代理结果保留

body.en: Preserve and recover subagent outcomes with a new SubagentOutcome envelope and typed errors.
body.zh: 使用新的 SubagentOutcome 封装和类型化错误保留并恢复子代理结果。

title.zh: 版本化会话上下文

body.en: Stabilized prompt prefixes by moving mutable environment and skill catalogs into deterministic session-context snapshots.
body.zh: 通过将可变环境和技能目录移入确定性会话上下文快照来稳定提示词前缀。

title.zh: 本地化主机提示

body.en: Moved user-visible agent host notices into the i18n catalog and synchronized language changes live.
body.zh: 将用户可见的 Agent 主机提示移入 i18n 目录，并实时同步语言更改。

title.zh: 下架经典桌面风格

body.en: Removed Classic layout from Settings and migrated existing classic configs to Workbench.
body.zh: 从设置中移除经典布局，并将现有经典配置迁移到工作台。

title.zh: 提供商能力兼容性

body.en: Restored legacy provider-level unsupported vision signal after model-level capability metadata became authoritative.
body.zh: 在模型级能力元数据成为权威后，恢复了旧版提供商级不支持视觉信号。

title.zh: 简化缺失推理恢复

body.en: Removed the long-lived fallback circuit; now one deterministic protocol retry before returning the provider-specific error.
body.zh: 移除了长期回退电路；现在在返回提供商特定错误前进行一次确定性协议重试。

title.zh: 管理命令分类

body.en: Management slash commands no longer require a durable turn ID, avoiding spurious errors.
body.zh: 管理斜杠命令不再需要持久回合 ID，避免虚假错误。

title.zh: 滚动跳动修复

body.en: Fixed reduced-motion compounding, block-window prepend absorption, and late range commit guard.
body.zh: 修复了减少动画叠加、块窗口前插吸收和延迟范围提交保护。

title.zh: 滚动条 generation 围栏

body.en: Fenced scrollbar transactions by generation to prevent stale geometry from causing jumps.
body.zh: 按 generation 围栏滚动条事务，防止旧几何导致跳动。

title.zh: 空代码围栏块

body.en: Omitted empty fenced code blocks to remove phantom cards.
body.zh: 省略空代码围栏块以移除幻影卡片。

title.zh: 崩溃仪表板 1101 修复

body.en: Bounded D1 group-detail reads and capped facets to prevent Worker 1101 errors.
body.zh: 限制 D1 分组详情读取并限制 facet 数量，防止 Worker 1101 错误。

title.zh: 网站 D1 查询优化

body.en: Added performance indexes and keyset pagination for forum and registry queries.
body.zh: 为论坛和注册表查询添加性能索引和 keyset 分页。

title.en: Reasonix 1.36: Sticky context pinning, session takeover, and long-file read enforcement
title.zh: Reasonix 1.36：粘性上下文固定、会话接管与长文件读取强制

summary.en: This release adds sticky context file pinning to Desktop, cooperative session takeover across Desktop and CLI, and enforced complete long-file reads. It also brings numerous stability and performance fixes for the CLI and Desktop.
summary.zh: 此版本为桌面端新增粘性上下文文件固定，为桌面端与 CLI 新增协作式会话接管，并强制完成长文件读取。同时带来大量 CLI 与桌面端的稳定性与性能修复。

title.zh: 会话所有权

body.en: Learn how cooperative session takeover and reclaim work across Desktop and CLI.
body.zh: 了解协作式会话接管与取回如何在桌面端与 CLI 之间工作。

title.zh: 会话所有权（中文）

body.en: Chinese guide to cooperative session takeover and reclaim across Desktop and CLI.
body.zh: 协作式会话接管与取回在桌面端和 CLI 中工作方式的中文指南。

title.zh: 粘性上下文文件固定

body.en: Pin workspace files to a session so they remain available verbatim after context compaction. Pinned files are delivered as append-only user-role revisions before the next accepted turn, without rewriting the system prompt or invalidating the prompt cache.
body.zh: 将会话中的工作区文件固定，使其在上下文压缩后仍可逐字保留。固定文件在下一次接受的轮次前以仅追加的用户角色修订形式传递，不会重写系统提示或使提示缓存失效。

title.zh: 协作式会话接管

body.en: Take over a session from another client with a cooperative handoff. Exactly one writer owns a session at a time; the other side stays attached as a read-only spectator and can reclaim ownership cooperatively.
body.zh: 通过协作式移交从另一个客户端接管会话。同一时间只有一个写入者拥有会话；另一方保持只读旁观状态，并可协作式取回所有权。

title.zh: 强制完成长文件读取

body.en: Long read_file results now use a dynamic budget and block mutations, finalizers, and final answers until every incomplete read is resolved. This prevents the model from silently missing rules near the end of a file.
body.zh: 长 read_file 结果现在使用动态预算，并阻止变更、终结器和最终答案，直到所有不完整读取得到解决。这可以防止模型静默遗漏文件末尾附近的规则。

title.en: Graceful watchdog exit and clock-jump tolerance
title.zh: watchdog 优雅退出与时钟跳变容忍

body.en: The interactive TUI no longer hard-kills on recoverable stalls and tolerates wall-clock jumps after suspend/resume, preventing false 'program was killed' errors on Windows.
body.zh: 交互式 TUI 不再在可恢复的停滞时硬杀进程，并容忍挂起/恢复后的时钟跳变，防止 Windows 上出现错误的“程序被杀死”错误。

title.zh: 防止 Ask 提示循环

body.en: Resolve missing local turn IDs from authoritative state before answering an Ask prompt, and fence cleanup by prompt ID and controller epoch so late completions cannot clear a newer prompt.
body.zh: 在回答 Ask 提示前从权威状态解析缺失的本地轮次 ID，并通过提示 ID 和控制器纪元隔离清理，使迟到的完成不会清除更新的提示。

title.zh: 粘性上下文文件固定

body.en: Pin workspace files to a session so they remain available verbatim after context compaction.
body.zh: 将会话中的工作区文件固定，使其在上下文压缩后仍可逐字保留。

title.zh: 协作式会话接管

body.en: Take over a session from another client with a cooperative handoff and reclaim ownership cooperatively.
body.zh: 通过协作式移交从另一个客户端接管会话，并协作式取回所有权。

title.zh: 强制完成长文件读取

body.en: Long read_file results now use a dynamic budget and block mutations, finalizers, and final answers until every incomplete read is resolved.
body.zh: 长 read_file 结果现在使用动态预算，并阻止变更、终结器和最终答案，直到所有不完整读取得到解决。

title.zh: 语义完成校验

body.en: Completion validation now defaults to enforce mode, using a model-based semantic check instead of keyword matching to prevent incomplete turns from being accepted.
body.zh: 完成校验现在默认使用 enforce 模式，采用基于模型的语义检查而非关键词匹配，防止接受不完整的轮次。

title.zh: 停止空闲 CPU 修复循环

body.en: The session catalog no longer replays recovery transcripts after strict verification, preventing idle CPU repair loops.
body.zh: 会话目录在严格验证后不再重放恢复转录，防止空闲 CPU 修复循环。

title.zh: 斜杠参数补全缓存

body.en: Slash argument completion data is now cached across keystrokes, eliminating input lag when a completion popup is open.
body.zh: 斜杠参数补全数据现在在按键间缓存，消除补全弹窗打开时的输入卡顿。

title.zh: Worktree 合并回主分支

body.en: Isolated worktrees now support one-click diff, conflict precheck, and merge-back to the main branch with failure-atomic safety.
body.zh: 隔离工作树现在支持一键差异对比、冲突预检与合并回主分支，并具备失败原子安全性。

title.en: Graceful watchdog exit and clock-jump tolerance
title.zh: watchdog 优雅退出与时钟跳变容忍

body.en: The interactive TUI no longer hard-kills on recoverable stalls and tolerates wall-clock jumps after suspend/resume.
body.zh: 交互式 TUI 不再在可恢复的停滞时硬杀进程，并容忍挂起/恢复后的时钟跳变。

title.zh: 防止 Ask 提示循环

body.en: Resolve missing local turn IDs from authoritative state before answering an Ask prompt, and fence cleanup by prompt ID and controller epoch.
body.zh: 在回答 Ask 提示前从权威状态解析缺失的本地轮次 ID，并通过提示 ID 和控制器纪元隔离清理。

title.zh: 剪贴板图片粘贴协商

body.en: On Wayland and X11, image paste now negotiates supported MIME types and falls back to text instead of silently failing.
body.zh: 在 Wayland 和 X11 上，图片粘贴现在协商支持的 MIME 类型，并在失败时回退到文本，而不是静默失败。

title.zh: SSH 会话强制同步输出

body.en: The TUI now forces synchronized output over SSH to eliminate flicker when typing in remote sessions.
body.zh: TUI 现在在 SSH 会话中强制同步输出，消除远程会话中输入时的闪烁。

title.zh: SSH 会话默认原生鼠标

body.en: SSH sessions now start with native mouse selection enabled by default, so users can select and copy terminal output.
body.zh: SSH 会话现在默认启用原生鼠标选择，使用户可以选择和复制终端输出。

title.zh: 控制器派发轮次时进入运行态

body.en: The TUI now enters running state when the controller auto-dispatches a queued follow-up, preventing input races and silent drops.
body.zh: 当控制器自动派发排队的后续任务时，TUI 现在进入运行状态，防止输入竞争和静默丢弃。

title.en: Strip block gutters from selection copy
title.zh: 应用内选区复制剥离装饰竖线

body.en: Copying rendered TUI output no longer includes application-owned gutters, while preserving literal glyphs and indentation.
body.zh: 复制渲染的 TUI 输出不再包含应用拥有的装饰竖线，同时保留字面字形和缩进。

title.en: Retain transcript anchor on plain click
title.zh: 修复普通点击触发会话回跳

body.en: Plain clicks on transcript content no longer cause the viewport to jump after manual scrolling.
body.zh: 手动滚动后，普通点击转录内容不再导致视口跳动。

title.zh: 修复 Ask 会话首次切换失败

body.en: An Ask prompt that arrives between topic activation ticketing and terminal readiness is now preserved.
body.zh: 在主题激活票据与终端就绪之间到达的 Ask 提示现在会被保留。

title.en: Surface /preset in completion, help, and status line
title.zh: 让 /preset 在 TUI 完成列表、帮助与状态栏可见

body.en: The /preset command now appears in slash completion, help, and the status line, with argument completion for standard and delivery.
body.zh: /preset 命令现在出现在斜杠补全、帮助和状态栏中，并提供 standard 和 delivery 的参数补全。

title.en: Name valid operations on unknown command
title.zh: 未知操作时列出有效操作

body.en: When rejecting an unknown operation, hook, session, and task now list the valid operations and echo the rejected name.
body.zh: 当拒绝未知操作时，hook、session 和 task 现在会列出有效操作并回显被拒绝的名称。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.35.0

summary.en: This release brings isolated Git worktree forks, chunked-summary recovery for over-length sessions, a simplified session recovery versions dialog, and numerous stability fixes for transcript scrolling, compaction, and session catalog identity.
summary.zh: 此版本带来隔离 Git Worktree 分叉、超长会话的分块摘要恢复、简化的会话恢复版本对话框，以及针对转录滚动、压缩和会话目录身份的众多稳定性修复。

title.zh: 会话所有权

body.en: Learn how isolated worktree forks and session ownership work.
body.zh: 了解隔离工作树分叉和会话所有权的工作原理。

title.zh: 会话所有权（中文）

body.en: Chinese guide for session ownership and isolated worktree forks.
body.zh: 会话所有权和隔离工作树分叉的中文指南。

title.zh: 会话目录

body.en: Understand session catalog identity and path handling.
body.zh: 了解会话目录身份和路径处理。

title.zh: 会话目录（中文）

body.en: Chinese guide for session catalog identity and path handling.
body.zh: 会话目录身份和路径处理的中文指南。

title.zh: 配置路径

body.en: Details on configuration paths and workspace-root identity.
body.zh: 配置路径和工作区根身份的详细信息。

title.zh: 配置路径（中文）

body.en: Chinese guide for configuration paths and workspace-root identity.
body.zh: 配置路径和工作区根身份的中文指南。

title.zh: 指南

body.en: General usage guide including YOLO mode /clear behavior.
body.zh: 一般使用指南，包括 YOLO 模式 /clear 行为。

title.zh: 指南（中文）

body.en: Chinese general usage guide including YOLO mode /clear behavior.
body.zh: 中文一般使用指南，包括 YOLO 模式 /clear 行为。

title.zh: 工具审批模式

body.en: Details on tool approval modes and YOLO /clear fast path.
body.zh: 工具审批模式和 YOLO /clear 快速路径的详细信息。

title.zh: 工具审批模式（中文）

body.en: Chinese guide for tool approval modes and YOLO /clear fast path.
body.zh: 工具审批模式和 YOLO /clear 快速路径的中文指南。

title.en: Fork conversations into isolated Git worktrees
title.zh: 将会话分叉至隔离 Git Worktree

body.en: You can now fork a conversation from any message turn into a new tab backed by a dedicated Git worktree, keeping exploratory work separate from your source checkout. Shared-workspace forks remain available.
body.zh: 现在可以从任意消息轮次将会话分叉到由专用 Git 工作树支持的新标签页，使探索性工作与源检出保持分离。共享工作区分叉仍然可用。

title.en: Recover over-length sessions with chunked summaries
title.zh: 使用分块摘要恢复超长会话

body.en: When a single summary request fails due to output truncation or window overflow, /compact now automatically falls back to chunked summaries with tree merging and installs a working compaction projection in the current session.
body.zh: 当单次摘要请求因输出截断或窗口溢出而失败时，/compact 现在会自动回退到分块摘要和树形归并，并在当前会话中安装可工作的压缩投影。

title.zh: 简化的会话恢复版本

body.en: Session recovery is now presented as a single lazy versions dialog. Covered recovery copies are hidden from ordinary history and grouped under a collapsed System recovery data section in Trash.
body.zh: 会话恢复现在以单一的延迟版本对话框呈现。被覆盖的恢复副本从普通历史中隐藏，并在回收站中归入折叠的“系统恢复数据”部分。

title.en: Stabilized transcript scrolling and history rendering
title.zh: 稳定转录滚动和历史渲染

body.en: Multiple fixes prevent visible jumps during history prepends, ensure historical markdown renders without waiting for bottom scroll, and stabilize same-tab tail takeover.
body.zh: 多项修复防止历史预置期间出现可见跳动，确保历史 Markdown 无需等待滚动到底即可渲染，并稳定同标签页尾部接管。

title.zh: 提高压缩可靠性

body.en: Automatic summary requests are now capped at the configured context window, manual compaction can escape over-ceiling deadlocks, and small shared windows remain admissible.
body.zh: 自动摘要请求现在按配置的上下文窗口封顶，手动压缩可以摆脱超顶死锁，小型共享窗口保持可接受。

title.zh: 统一会话目录路径身份

body.en: Session catalog now uses filesystem-aware identity keys, preventing duplicate entries on case-insensitive filesystems and preserving distinct paths on case-sensitive ones.
body.zh: 会话目录现在使用文件系统感知的身份键，防止在大小写不敏感的文件系统上出现重复条目，并在大小写敏感的文件系统上保留不同路径。

title.zh: 失败会话可归档

body.en: Terminally failed sessions no longer cause restart loops and can be archived through the regular TrashTopic path.
body.zh: 最终失败的会话不再导致重启循环，并可通过常规 TrashTopic 路径归档。

title.zh: 回滚选择器显示用户提示

body.en: The rewind picker now correctly strips interleaved compose prefixes and records raw prompts, so you can see your own words instead of injected notices.
body.zh: 回滚选择器现在正确剥离交错的组合前缀并记录原始提示，因此您可以看到自己的话语而不是注入的通知。

title.zh: YOLO 模式跳过 /clear 确认

body.en: In YOLO mode, /clear now clears the session immediately without a confirmation overlay.
body.zh: 在 YOLO 模式下，/clear 现在立即清除会话，无需确认覆盖层。

title.en: Fork conversations into isolated Git worktrees
title.zh: 将会话分叉至隔离 Git Worktree

body.en: Fork from any message turn into a new tab backed by a dedicated Git worktree. Isolated forks create a reasonix/delivery-* branch and linked worktree from the committed HEAD. Shared forks keep the current directory and uncommitted changes. A dirty source checkout blocks isolated creation and asks to commit/stash or use a shared fork. When prerequisites are unavailable, the conversation falls back to shared workspace with a visible notice. Successfully referenced isolated worktrees are registered as projects and remain discoverable after closing a tab or restarting.
body.zh: 从任意消息轮次分叉到由专用 Git 工作树支持的新标签页。隔离分叉从已提交的 HEAD 创建 reasonix/delivery-* 分支和关联工作树。共享分叉保留当前目录和未提交的更改。源检出脏时阻止隔离创建，并要求提交/暂存或使用共享分叉。当先决条件不可用时，会话回退到共享工作区并显示可见通知。成功引用的隔离工作树注册为项目，关闭标签页或重启后仍可发现。

title.zh: /compact 的分块摘要回退

body.en: When a single summary request fails, /compact automatically splits the fold into replay-safe, exponentially sized chunks with overlap, summarizes fragments, tree-reduces briefings, and installs the resulting CompactionModeChunked projection in the current session without a second command.
body.zh: 当单次摘要请求失败时，/compact 自动将折叠拆分为可重放、指数大小且带重叠的块，总结片段，树形归并简报，并在当前会话中安装生成的 CompactionModeChunked 投影，无需第二次命令。

title.zh: 简化的会话恢复版本

body.en: Recovery safety net remains, but physical recovery-copy concepts are removed from ordinary project-tree and history workflows. One non-blocking notification appears only after the catalog confirms a real divergent lineage, and both the notification and History route through the same lazy Session versions dialog. Covered copies are hidden from ordinary History and grouped under a collapsed System recovery data section in Trash. Opening a version does not change the default; choosing a default version does not delete, overwrite, merge, or make another divergent version cleanup-eligible.
body.zh: 恢复安全网保留，但物理恢复副本概念从普通项目树和历史工作流中移除。仅在目录确认真实分歧谱系后显示一个非阻塞通知，通知和历史都通过相同的延迟会话版本对话框。被覆盖的副本从普通历史中隐藏，并在回收站中归入折叠的“系统恢复数据”部分。打开版本不会更改默认值；选择默认版本不会删除、覆盖、合并或使另一个分歧版本符合清理条件。

title.zh: 自动摘要请求封顶

body.en: Automatic pressure/overflow summaries are capped for shared and unknown gateways. Unknown gateways honor the effective configured or learned window. Shared/unknown summaries scale their output cap as min(8192, max(window/4, 512)), while independent-window providers retain the full 8192-token cap. Summary execution uses the same dedicated protocol reserve as planning, and compaction.prepare replacements are revalidated against the final-request limit.
body.zh: 自动压力/溢出摘要对共享和未知网关进行封顶。未知网关遵循有效配置或学习到的窗口。共享/未知摘要的输出上限缩放为 min(8192, max(window/4, 512))，而独立窗口提供者保留完整的 8192 令牌上限。摘要执行使用与规划相同的专用协议储备，compaction.prepare 替换根据最终请求限制重新验证。

title.en: Manual compaction escape from over-ceiling deadlock
title.zh: 手动压缩摆脱超顶死锁

body.en: Over the ceiling, a manual compact now prunes first, uses safe-prefix folding, and runs a rescue loop of up to 4 batches, each carrying the prior digest, until the view is under the ceiling or no balanced prefix remains. Below the ceiling, manual semantics are unchanged.
body.zh: 超过上限时，手动压缩现在先修剪，使用安全前缀折叠，并运行最多 4 个批次的救援循环，每个批次携带先前的摘要，直到视图低于上限或没有平衡前缀剩余。低于上限时，手动语义不变。

title.zh: 缩放共享窗口准入缓冲

body.en: The ordinary shared-window admission cushion now scales with the effective context window: 1/128, with a 256-token floor and 8K cap. This keeps small shared windows admissible and prevents unnecessary overflow folds.
body.zh: 普通共享窗口准入缓冲现在随有效上下文窗口缩放：1/128，下限 256 令牌，上限 8K。这使小型共享窗口保持可接受，并防止不必要的溢出折叠。

title.en: Unified filesystem path identity in session catalog
title.zh: 会话目录中统一的文件系统路径身份

body.en: Session catalog now separates original access spellings from filesystem-aware identity keys, used for Desktop and CLI targets, SQLite uniqueness, workspace relationships, scans, indexing, tombstones, repair ownership, and directory locks. Distinct /Foo and /foo entries are preserved on case-sensitive filesystems while equivalent spellings coalesce on case-insensitive ones. The disposable catalog moves to v6.sqlite with schema migration through v10.
body.zh: 会话目录现在将原始访问拼写与文件系统感知的身份键分离，用于桌面和 CLI 目标、SQLite 唯一性、工作区关系、扫描、索引、墓碑、修复所有权和目录锁。在大小写敏感的文件系统上保留不同的 /Foo 和 /foo 条目，而在大小写不敏感的文件系统上合并等效拼写。一次性目录移至 v6.sqlite，模式迁移至 v10。

title.zh: 失败会话可归档

body.en: Terminal session recovery failures no longer create restart loops. The filtered desktop-tabs.json snapshot is persisted immediately, and terminally failed sessions can be archived through the regular TrashTopic path without bypassing active-work protection.
body.zh: 最终会话恢复失败不再导致重启循环。过滤后的 desktop-tabs.json 快照立即持久化，最终失败的会话可通过常规 TrashTopic 路径归档，而不会绕过活动工作保护。

title.zh: 回滚选择器显示用户提示

body.en: The rewind picker now strips interleaved compose prefixes to a fixpoint and records raw prompts in the headless run path, so labels show the user's own words instead of injected notices.
body.zh: 回滚选择器现在将交错的组合前缀剥离到固定点，并在无头运行路径中记录原始提示，因此标签显示用户自己的话语而不是注入的通知。

title.zh: YOLO 模式跳过 /clear 确认

body.en: In YOLO mode, /clear clears the session immediately without a confirmation overlay. Non-YOLO modes keep the existing confirmation.
body.zh: 在 YOLO 模式下，/clear 立即清除会话，无需确认覆盖层。非 YOLO 模式保留现有确认。

title.zh: 稳定分页历史预置

body.en: Complex transcripts no longer visibly jump while older history is prepended. The fix captures the visible reader anchor by stable row key, holds contiguous pages under one generation-bound lease, fences reader correction until mounted coverage is stable, and routes the only physical correction through the existing generation-fenced scroll writer.
body.zh: 复杂转录在预置较旧历史时不再出现可见跳动。修复通过稳定行键捕获可见阅读器锚点，在一个代际绑定租约下持有连续页面，在挂载覆盖稳定之前隔离阅读器校正，并通过现有的代际隔离滚动写入器路由唯一的物理校正。

title.zh: 有界转录预置提交

body.en: History-prepend geometry commits now have a wall-clock bound independent from reader input settling, preventing repeated downward wheels from postponing a covered prepend forever and blocking reader-to-tail handoff.
body.zh: 历史预置几何提交现在具有独立于阅读器输入稳定的墙钟界限，防止重复向下滚动无限期推迟已覆盖的预置并阻止阅读器到尾部交接。

title.zh: 稳定有界转录尾部确认

body.en: Tail-settle phase/frame metadata remains functional in Stable builds so bounded same-revision retries are not deduplicated. Repeat confirmation is required before treating a small WebView2 no-op residual as the reachable tail, while explicit jump-bottom still probes the theoretical physical extent.
body.zh: 尾部稳定阶段/帧元数据在稳定构建中保持功能，因此有界同修订重试不会被去重。在将小型 WebView2 无操作残差视为可达尾部之前需要重复确认，而显式跳到底部仍探测理论物理范围。

title.zh: 稳定同标签页转录尾部接管

body.en: Same-tab model takeover and reconnect now converge through the generation-bound tail transaction that actually runs on this path. A reveal-generation change synchronously invalidates the old layout surface, the incoming first-items transaction owns the tail, and wheel intent cancels delayed confirmations so the reader is never yanked back.
body.zh: 同标签页模型接管和重连现在通过实际在此路径上运行的代际绑定尾部事务收敛。揭示代际更改同步使旧布局表面失效，传入的首项事务拥有尾部，滚轮意图取消延迟确认，因此阅读器永远不会被拉回。

title.en: Historical markdown renders without waiting for bottom
title.zh: 历史 Markdown 无需等待底部即可渲染

body.en: Historical Markdown parsing can finish while the reader is above the transcript bottom. MarkdownHistory now classifies the actual Virtuoso row against the actual .transcript scroller: answers within the bounded tail window render immediately, mounted long rows outside the viewport render immediately, and long rows intersecting the reader viewport keep the complete fallback until the reader returns to the shared native reachable bottom.
body.zh: 历史 Markdown 解析可以在阅读器位于转录底部上方时完成。MarkdownHistory 现在根据实际的 .transcript 滚动器对实际的 Virtuoso 行进行分类：有界尾部窗口内的答案立即渲染，视口外已挂载的长行立即渲染，与阅读器视口相交的长行保留完整回退，直到阅读器返回共享的原生可达底部。

title.zh: 恢复发布包体预算余量

body.en: The merged isolated-worktree startup graph is measured at 2454.719 KiB, and 0.081 KiB of explicit headroom is retained with the existing one-decimal ratchet. All gzip, chunk, locale, and CSS budgets remain unchanged.
body.zh: 合并的隔离工作树启动图测量为 2454.719 KiB，并通过现有的一位小数棘轮保留 0.081 KiB 的显式余量。所有 gzip、块、区域设置和 CSS 预算保持不变。

title.zh: kill_shell 归类为仅主机状态变更

body.en: kill_shell no longer enters workspace write coordination or waits for the target job's path lease, preventing a self-blocking lifecycle operation when terminating a background job.
body.zh: kill_shell 不再进入工作区写协调或等待目标作业的路径租约，防止在终止后台作业时出现自阻塞生命周期操作。

title.zh: Reasonix 1.34.0

summary.en: Security hardening for serve and git operations, MCP 2026 interactions and Apps, cache-stable capability controls, and multiple desktop stability fixes.
summary.zh: serve 与 git 操作的安全加固、MCP 2026 交互与 Apps、缓存稳定的能力控制，以及多项桌面稳定性修复。

title.zh: 子代理配置文件

body.en: Documentation for subagent profiles.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件文档。

title.zh: 子代理配置文件（中文）

body.en: Chinese documentation for subagent profiles.
body.zh: 子代理配置文件中文文档。

title.zh: 任务契约

body.en: Documentation for the task contract.
body.zh: 任务契约文档。

title.zh: 任务契约（中文）

body.en: Chinese documentation for the task contract.
body.zh: 任务契约中文文档。

title.zh: 工具契约

body.en: Documentation for the tool contract.
body.zh: 工具契约文档。

title.zh: 工具契约（中文）

body.en: Chinese documentation for the tool contract.
body.zh: 工具契约中文文档。

title.zh: 能力使用回放

body.en: Documentation for capability replay evaluation.
body.zh: 能力使用回放评估文档。

title.zh: 能力使用回放（中文）

body.en: Chinese documentation for capability replay evaluation.
body.zh: 能力使用回放评估中文文档。

title.zh: MCP 2026 Apps

body.en: Documentation for MCP 2026 Apps support.
body.zh: MCP 2026 Apps 支持文档。

title.zh: MCP 2026 交互与 Apps

body.en: Added support for MCP 2026 multi-round interactions and Desktop Apps with sandboxed rendering.
body.zh: 新增对 MCP 2026 多轮交互和桌面 Apps 的支持，并采用沙箱渲染。

title.zh: 缓存稳定的能力控制

body.en: Landed use_capability speed and quality controls, including parallel scheduling, review budgets, and metrics.
body.zh: 落地 use_capability 的速度与质量控制，包括并行调度、审查预算和指标。

title.zh: serve 与 git 操作安全加固

body.en: Closed six security-boundary gaps including DNS rebinding, preview confinement, and git clean-filter neutralization.
body.zh: 封堵六个安全边界缺口，包括 DNS 重绑定、预览越界读与 git clean 过滤器执行。

title.zh: 稳定对话滚动

body.en: Fixed transcript reader transactions to prevent reverse jumps and blank frames during high-speed reasoning.
body.zh: 修复对话阅读滚动事务，防止高速推理时的反向跳跃和空白帧。

title.zh: 修复多轮思考时间线

body.en: Fixed multi-round reasoning overwrites and tool timeline misalignment in the same turn.
body.zh: 修复同一 turn 内多次模型采样导致的多轮思考覆盖和工具时间线错位。

title.zh: 修复输入框自动高度抖动

body.en: Fixed composer autosize causing session viewport bounce by using an off-flow textarea mirror.
body.zh: 通过使用离流 textarea 镜像修复输入框自动高度导致的会话视口抖动。

title.en: Aligned model discovery with chat proxy policy
title.zh: 修复自定义供应商刷新正常但对话无响应

body.en: Fixed custom provider model discovery using a different network policy than chat, and made stream failures visible.
body.zh: 修复自定义供应商模型发现与聊天使用不同网络策略的问题，并使流失败可见。

title.en: Kept remote project roots out of local topic state
title.zh: 远端项目根不再触碰本地 Topic 元数据

body.en: Fixed a user-visible toast error when opening remote projects on Windows due to invalid path components.
body.zh: 修复在 Windows 上打开远端项目时因无效路径组件导致的用户可见 toast 错误。

title.en: Kept new-session blank row visible in remote groups
title.zh: 远端项目组新会话行稳定显示

body.en: Fixed the new-session blank row flashing and disappearing in remote workspace sidebars.
body.zh: 修复远端工作区侧边栏中新会话行闪烁后消失的问题。

title.en: Kept write path alive across in-place resume
title.zh: 修复 /resume 之后 /new 报写授权缺失

body.en: Fixed a 500 error when creating a new session after an in-place resume due to missing write authority.
body.zh: 修复原地 /resume 后创建新会话时因写授权缺失导致的 500 错误。

title.zh: 修复 Streamable HTTP 兼容性

body.en: Fixed MCP Streamable HTTP compatibility issues with stateless bridges and pinned the Go MCP SDK.
body.zh: 修复 MCP Streamable HTTP 与无状态桥接的兼容性问题，并固定 Go MCP SDK。

title.zh: MCP 2026 交互与 Apps

body.en: Added support for MCP 2026 multi-round interactions and Desktop Apps with sandboxed rendering.
body.zh: 新增对 MCP 2026 多轮交互和桌面 Apps 的支持，并采用沙箱渲染。

title.zh: 缓存稳定的能力控制

body.en: Landed use_capability speed and quality controls, including parallel scheduling, review budgets, and metrics.
body.zh: 落地 use_capability 的速度与质量控制，包括并行调度、审查预算和指标。

title.zh: 稳定对话滚动

body.en: Improved transcript reader transactions to prevent reverse jumps and blank frames during high-speed reasoning.
body.zh: 改进对话阅读滚动事务，防止高速推理时的反向跳跃和空白帧。

title.zh: 修复多轮思考时间线

body.en: Improved multi-round reasoning timeline rendering and tool timeline alignment.
body.zh: 改进多轮思考时间线渲染和工具时间线对齐。

title.zh: 修复输入框自动高度抖动

body.en: Improved composer autosize to prevent session viewport bounce.
body.zh: 改进输入框自动高度，防止会话视口抖动。

title.en: Aligned model discovery with chat proxy policy
title.zh: 修复自定义供应商刷新正常但对话无响应

body.en: Improved custom provider model discovery to use the same network policy as chat, and made stream failures visible.
body.zh: 改进自定义供应商模型发现以使用与聊天相同的网络策略，并使流失败可见。

title.zh: 修复 Streamable HTTP 兼容性

body.en: Improved MCP Streamable HTTP compatibility with stateless bridges and pinned the Go MCP SDK.
body.zh: 改进 MCP Streamable HTTP 与无状态桥接的兼容性，并固定 Go MCP SDK。

title.zh: serve 与 git 操作安全加固

body.en: Fixed six security-boundary gaps including DNS rebinding, preview confinement, and git clean-filter neutralization.
body.zh: 修复六个安全边界缺口，包括 DNS 重绑定、预览越界读与 git clean 过滤器执行。

title.en: Kept remote project roots out of local topic state
title.zh: 远端项目根不再触碰本地 Topic 元数据

body.en: Fixed a user-visible toast error when opening remote projects on Windows due to invalid path components.
body.zh: 修复在 Windows 上打开远端项目时因无效路径组件导致的用户可见 toast 错误。

title.en: Kept new-session blank row visible in remote groups
title.zh: 远端项目组新会话行稳定显示

body.en: Fixed the new-session blank row flashing and disappearing in remote workspace sidebars.
body.zh: 修复远端工作区侧边栏中新会话行闪烁后消失的问题。

title.en: Kept write path alive across in-place resume
title.zh: 修复 /resume 之后 /new 报写授权缺失

body.en: Fixed a 500 error when creating a new session after an in-place resume due to missing write authority.
body.zh: 修复原地 /resume 后创建新会话时因写授权缺失导致的 500 错误。

title.zh: Reasonix v1.33.0

summary.en: This release adds MCP 2026 elicitation and stable MCP Apps, improves shell configuration, remote credential security, interface stability, and notification volume control.
summary.zh: 此版本新增 MCP 2026 交互与稳定版 MCP Apps，并改进 Shell 配置、远程凭据安全性、界面稳定性和通知音量控制。

title.zh: MCP 2026 能力面

body.en: Host capability profiles, capability negotiation, elicitation, Apps sandboxing, and the cross-version cache contract.
body.zh: 宿主能力分层、能力协商、交互流程、Apps 沙箱与跨版本缓存契约。

title.zh: MCP 2026 交互与稳定版 Apps

body.en: Added MCP 2026-07-28 multi-round-trip form and URL elicitation plus stable MCP Apps 2026-01-26 on Desktop, with explicit capability negotiation and safe cross-version fallbacks.
body.zh: 新增 MCP 2026-07-28 多轮表单及 URL 交互，并在桌面端支持稳定版 MCP Apps 2026-01-26，同时提供显式能力协商与安全的跨版本回退。

title.zh: 安全的跨平台 Shell 支持

body.en: Added a process-level cached shell inventory with deterministic Git for Windows discovery. macOS resolves Bash, native zsh, and POSIX sh; Linux execution remains Bash-only. Git is modeled as an independent capability. Windows repair is manual-only, and macOS/Linux repair guidance provides copy-only commands.
body.zh: 新增进程级缓存的 Shell 清单，并支持确定性的 Git for Windows 发现。macOS 可解析 Bash、原生 zsh 和 POSIX sh；Linux 执行仍仅限 Bash。Git 被建模为独立能力。Windows 修复仅支持手动操作，macOS/Linux 修复指导仅提供复制命令。

title.zh: 稳定的运行任务切换

body.en: Fixed interface jitter during task execution by keeping reasoning and process disclosures open throughout the active turn lifecycle and using a monotonic height floor to stabilize live footer commits.
body.zh: 修复了任务执行期间的界面抽动问题，通过在整个活动轮次生命周期内保持推理和进程披露展开，并使用单调高度下限稳定实时页脚提交。

title.zh: 安全的远程凭据代理路由

body.en: Remote local proxy routes now keep stable scoped virtual tokens while the desktop holds real provider credentials. Saving, clearing, or deleting credentials synchronously rebuilds or revokes only affected routes, and revoked tokens return HTTP 401.
body.zh: 远程本地代理路由现在保持稳定的作用域虚拟令牌，而桌面端持有真实提供商凭据。保存、清除或删除凭据会同步重建或撤销仅受影响的路由，被撤销的令牌返回 HTTP 401。

title.zh: 可调通知音量

body.en: Added a 0–100% notification volume slider in Sound settings with a default of 70%. All notification sounds now route through one master gain, normalizing bundled WAV assets to consistent loudness.
body.zh: 在声音设置中新增 0–100% 的通知音量滑块，默认值为 70%。所有通知声音现在通过一个主增益路由，将内置 WAV 资源标准化为一致的响度。
